literature.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: CHB 患者表现出未转换记忆和双阴性 1 B 细胞亚群的扩张,并伴有类别转换受损、共刺激分子表达改变、克隆扩张增加、IGHV 基因使用偏向、体细胞超突变增加、氧化磷酸化增加以及 HBsAg 特异性 B 细胞中谷氨酰胺代谢减少。 [10.1097/hc9.0000000000000994]
参与者中自我报告的 HepB 诊断很少,0.6% (13/2,358) 报告之前有过 诊断。自我报告阳性疫苗接种病史的比例为56.3%(1,225/2,175)。不同亚组的积极 疫苗接种 历史各不相同,与农村地区相比,男性、受教育程度较高的参与者以及大城市参与者的比例较高。随着已知肝炎事实数量的增加,疫苗接种 病史阳性的比例也随之增加。 [10.1186/s12889-026-28677-3]
显微镜检查显示,PTB 抑制含有内含子的 CPS-PRE 小基因转录本的核输出,导致其核保留。RNA 免疫沉淀证明 CPS-PRE 转录本与 NXF1-NXT1 输出机制存在稳定的相互作用,而未检测到与核转运蛋白 CRM1 途径的相互作用。 [10.1007/s13337-026-00978-6]
该文章最初报道的研究结果表明,大戟提取物通过 α 丝氨酸/苏氨酸蛋白激酶和 Caspase-3 抑制 乙型肝炎病毒 相关的肝细胞癌。然而,由于担心可重复性,这些结果现在被撤回。 [10.1007/s00432-026-06572-z]
摘要指出,现有的系统评价提供了关于 CHB-MASLD 相互作用的相互矛盾的证据,表明尚未达成明确的共识。 [10.12688/wellcomeopenres.26466.2]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: CHB patients showed expansion of unswitched memory and double-negative 1 B cell subsets with impaired class switching, altered co-stimulatory molecule expression, increased clonal expansion, biased IGHV gene usage, elevated somatic hypermutation, increased oxidative phosphorylation, and reduced glutamine metabolism in HBsAg-specific B cells. [10.1097/hc9.0000000000000994]

Self-reported HepB diagnoses were rare among participants, with 0.6% (13/2,358) reporting a previous diagnosis. The proportion of self-reported positive vaccination history was 56.3% (1,225/2,175). [10.1186/s12889-026-28677-3]
Microscopy showed that PTB inhibits nuclear export of the intron-containing CPS-PRE minigene transcript, resulting in its nuclear retention. [10.1007/s13337-026-00978-6]

The article originally reported findings suggesting that Euphorbia helioscopia L. extract suppresses hepatitis B virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma via alpha serine/threonine-protein kinase and Caspase-3. However, these results are now retracted due to concerns about reproducibility. [10.1007/s00432-026-06572-z]
The abstract notes that existing systematic reviews provide conflicting evidence on the CHB‐MASLD interplay, indicating no clear consensus yet. [10.12688/wellcomeopenres.26466.2]

papers.title: Prevalence of Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Cameroon: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.abstract: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a global public health problem, and many regions of Sub-Saharan Africa are disproportionately affected, including Cameroon, where prevalence has previously been shown to be high. This study aimed to provide up-to-date estimates of HBV prevalence in Cameroon. We searched Medline, Global Health, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Africa Index Medicus and the Journal of Health Science and Disease at the University of Yaounde. We included studies reporting HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) prevalence in the general population and subpopulations. A random-effects meta-analysis was used to generate pooled estimates of HBsAg prevalence, overall and for population subgroups including those considered at relatively higher-risk and relatively lower-risk of HBV infection. Heterogeneity was assessed using the index of heterogeneity (I 2 ). Quality was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tool. Out of 1236 records, 92 papers with 100 studies were included in the meta-analysis. Overall prevalence of HBV in Cameroon was 9.98% (95% confidence interval [CI] 9.00-11.02) with high heterogeneity (I 2 = 98.10%). The prevalences for relatively lower-risk and higher-risk populations were8.94% (95% CI 7.84-10.11) and 12.70% (95% CI 10.28-15.32), respectively. In subgroup analyses, we found that sex, geographical area (regions), population risk groups and study design were the main sources of heterogeneity. Overall, HBV prevalence remains high in Cameroon. Our findings suggest an urgent need for health interventions to halt the spread of the disease, with particular attention needed for males and regions with the highest prevalence.

papers.title_original: Prevalence of Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Cameroon: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines human hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in Cameroon, focusing on the central question of estimating HBV prevalence in the general population and subpopulations using HBsAg seropositivity as the diagnostic marker.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a systematic review and meta-analysis that searched Medline, Global Health, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Africa Index Medicus, and the Journal of Health Science and Disease at the University of Yaounde. Eligible studies reported HBsAg prevalence in the general population and subpopulations, assessed using a random-effects meta-analysis with heterogeneity quantified by I2 and study quality evaluated via the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tool. A total of 92 papers with 100 studies were included.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The pooled overall HBV prevalence in Cameroon is 9.98% (95% CI 9.00–11.02) with high heterogeneity (I2 = 98.10%). Prevalence is higher in relatively higher-risk populations (12.70%, 95% CI 10.28–15.32) compared to relatively lower-risk populations (8.94%, 95% CI 7.84–10.11). Subgroup analyses identified sex, geographical area (regions), population risk groups, and study design as major sources of heterogeneity.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review reports substantial heterogeneity (I2 = 98.10%) that remains largely unexplained despite subgroup analyses, indicating potential unmeasured confounders or methodological inconsistencies across included studies. The high heterogeneity limits the precision of pooled estimates and complicates interpretation of regional and population-specific differences.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings underscore the need for targeted public health interventions, particularly for males and regions with the highest HBV prevalence, to reduce transmission and improve control measures in Cameroon. Standardized study designs and reporting across future prevalence studies are required to address heterogeneity and improve comparability.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis provides updated estimates of hepatitis B virus (HBV) prevalence in Cameroon, reporting an overall pooled prevalence of 9.98% (95% CI 9.00–11.02) with high heterogeneity (I2 = 98.10%). Prevalence is higher in higher-risk populations (12.70%) than in lower-risk populations (8.94%). Subgroup analyses indicate that sex, geographical area, population risk group, and study design are key sources of heterogeneity. The review highlights the urgent need for targeted interventions, especially among males and in high-prevalence regions, and calls for standardized methodologies in future prevalence studies to reduce heterogeneity and improve comparability.

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review examines human hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in Cameroon, focusing on the central question of estimating HBV prevalence in the general population and subpopulations using HBsAg seropositivity as the diagnostic marker.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a systematic review and meta-analysis that searched Medline, Global Health, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Africa Index Medicus, and the Journal of Health Science and Disease at the University of Yaounde. Eligible studies reported HBsAg prevalence in the general population and subpopulations, assessed using a random-effects meta-analysis with heterogeneity quantified by I2 and study quality evaluated via the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tool. A total of 92 papers with 100 studies were included.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The pooled overall HBV prevalence in Cameroon is 9.98% (95% CI 9.00–11.02) with high heterogeneity (I2 = 98.10%). Prevalence is higher in relatively higher-risk populations (12.70%, 95% CI 10.28–15.32) compared to relatively lower-risk populations (8.94%, 95% CI 7.84–10.11). Subgroup analyses identified sex, geographical area (regions), population risk groups, and study design as major sources of heterogeneity.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review reports substantial heterogeneity (I2 = 98.10%) that remains largely unexplained despite subgroup analyses, indicating potential unmeasured confounders or methodological inconsistencies across included studies. The high heterogeneity limits the precision of pooled estimates and complicates interpretation of regional and population-specific differences.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The findings underscore the need for targeted public health interventions, particularly for males and regions with the highest HBV prevalence, to reduce transmission and improve control measures in Cameroon. Standardized study designs and reporting across future prevalence studies are required to address heterogeneity and improve comparability.

papers.title_zh: 喀麦隆 患病率 感染的 患病率:系统回顾和荟萃分析。
papers.source_body_en: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a global public health problem, and many regions of Sub-Saharan Africa are disproportionately affected, including Cameroon, where prevalence has previously been shown to be high. This study aimed to provide up-to-date estimates of HBV prevalence in Cameroon. We searched Medline, Global Health, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Africa Index Medicus and the Journal of Health Science and Disease at the University of Yaounde. We included studies reporting HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) prevalence in the general population and subpopulations. A random-effects meta-analysis was used to generate pooled estimates of HBsAg prevalence, overall and for population subgroups including those considered at relatively higher-risk and relatively lower-risk of HBV infection. Heterogeneity was assessed using the index of heterogeneity (I 2 ). Quality was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tool. Out of 1236 records, 92 papers with 100 studies were included in the meta-analysis. Overall prevalence of HBV in Cameroon was 9.98% (95% confidence interval [CI] 9.00-11.02) with high heterogeneity (I 2 = 98.10%). The prevalences for relatively lower-risk and higher-risk populations were8.94% (95% CI 7.84-10.11) and 12.70% (95% CI 10.28-15.32), respectively. In subgroup analyses, we found that sex, geographical area (regions), population risk groups and study design were the main sources of heterogeneity. Overall, HBV prevalence remains high in Cameroon. Our findings suggest an urgent need for health interventions to halt the spread of the disease, with particular attention needed for males and regions with the highest prevalence.

papers.title: Barriers to Hepatitis B Treatment: A Multicentre Cross-Sectional Registry and Survey Study by the Canadian Hepatitis B Network.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a leading cause of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) worldwide, yet treatment uptake is suboptimal even in high-resource settings. This pan-Canadian study aimed to quantify treatment gaps within the Canadian Hepatitis B Network (CanHepB) Registry, compare characteristics of treatment-eligible but untreated patients to those receiving therapy, and assess patient and specialist perspectives on barriers to treatment. METHODS: A cross-sectional, retrospective analysis of 1983 adults with CHB followed in 18 Canadian hepatitis B specialty clinics between January 2018 and November 2024. Treatment eligibility was determined using the 2018 Canadian Association for the Study of the Liver guidelines. An anonymous survey captured patient-reported barriers and perspectives (n = 191), while a separate survey evaluated specialist perceptions (n = 54). RESULTS: Among 881 untreated patients, 46.4% (n = 409) were treatment eligible. Compared with the treatment group (n = 1087), the treatment-eligible but untreated patients were younger (median 47.3 vs. 54.5 years), more frequently female (54.2% vs. 39.7%), and more likely to be of Black/African/Caribbean origin (18.2% vs. They had a lower prevalence of cirrhosis (2.4% vs. 20.3%), HCC (0.7% vs. 9.3%), and hypertension (17.1% vs. 22.9%), but a higher prevalence of steatotic liver disease (36.4% vs. 24.6%) and dyslipidemia (14.7% vs. Among untreated respondents, concerns included side effects, the need for long-term therapy, and lack of curative options. Conversely, specialists identified cost as the primary barrier and side effects as the least concerning. CONCLUSION: This nationwide study reveals a significant treatment gap in CHB care, driven by demographic disparities and a mismatch between patient concerns and clinician perceptions.

papers.title_zh: 乙型肝炎的障碍 治疗:加拿大乙型肝炎网络进行的多中心横断面登记和调查研究。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains a leading cause of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) worldwide, yet treatment uptake is suboptimal even in high-resource settings. This pan-Canadian study aimed to quantify treatment gaps within the Canadian Hepatitis B Network (CanHepB) Registry, compare characteristics of treatment-eligible but untreated patients to those receiving therapy, and assess patient and specialist perspectives on barriers to treatment. METHODS: A cross-sectional, retrospective analysis of 1983 adults with CHB followed in 18 Canadian hepatitis B specialty clinics between January 2018 and November 2024. Treatment eligibility was determined using the 2018 Canadian Association for the Study of the Liver guidelines. An anonymous survey captured patient-reported barriers and perspectives (n = 191), while a separate survey evaluated specialist perceptions (n = 54). RESULTS: Among 881 untreated patients, 46.4% (n = 409) were treatment eligible. Compared with the treatment group (n = 1087), the treatment-eligible but untreated patients were younger (median 47.3 vs. 54.5 years), more frequently female (54.2% vs. 39.7%), and more likely to be of Black/African/Caribbean origin (18.2% vs. They had a lower prevalence of cirrhosis (2.4% vs. 20.3%), HCC (0.7% vs. 9.3%), and hypertension (17.1% vs. 22.9%), but a higher prevalence of steatotic liver disease (36.4% vs. 24.6%) and dyslipidemia (14.7% vs. Among untreated respondents, concerns included side effects, the need for long-term therapy, and lack of curative options. Conversely, specialists identified cost as the primary barrier and side effects as the least concerning. CONCLUSION: This nationwide study reveals a significant treatment gap in CHB care, driven by demographic disparities and a mismatch between patient concerns and clinician perceptions.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景与目的:慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 仍然是全世界肝硬化和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的主要原因,但即使在资源丰富的环境中,治疗 的摄取也不是最佳的。这项泛加拿大研究旨在量化加拿大乙型肝炎网络 (CanHepB) 注册中心内的 治疗 差距,比较符合 治疗 资格但未经治疗的患者与正在接受治疗的患者的特征,并评估患者和专家对 治疗 障碍的看法。方法:对 2018 年 1 月至 2024 年 11 月期间加拿大 18 个乙型肝炎专科诊所的 1983 名成人慢性乙型肝炎患者进行横断面回顾性分析。治疗 资格是根据 2018 年加拿大肝脏研究协会指南确定的。一项匿名调查记录了患者报告的障碍和观点 (n = 191),而另一项调查评估了专家的看法 (n = 54)。结果:在 881 名未经治疗的患者中,46.4% (n = 409) 符合 治疗 资格。与 治疗 组 (n = 1087) 相比,符合 治疗 条件但未接受治疗的患者更年轻(中位年龄 47.3 岁 vs. 54.5 岁),女性更常见(54.2% vs. 39.7%),并且更有可能是黑人/非洲/加勒比裔(18.2% vs. 他们的 患病率 较低)肝硬化(2.4% vs. 20.3%)、肝癌(0.7% vs. 9.3%)和高血压(17.1% vs. 22.9%),但脂肪变性肝病(36.4% vs. 24.6%)和血脂异常(14.7% vs. 未治疗的受访者)的 患病率 较高。在未治疗的受访者中,担忧包括副作用、需要长期治疗以及缺乏治疗。相反,专家认为成本是主要障碍,而副作用是最不令人担忧的。这项全国性研究揭示了慢性乙型肝炎护理中存在显着的 治疗 差距,这是由人口差异以及患者关注点和临床医生认知之间的不匹配造成的。

papers.title: Attendance Among People With Hepatitis B in UK Secondary Care: A Scoping Review.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Chronic Hepatitis B disease requires lifelong monitoring to prevent complications such as cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Despite structured care pathways, non‐attendance within UK secondary care remains challenging. This scoping review aimed to synthesise existing evidence on factors influencing non‐attendance at secondary care appointments and strategies to improve appointment adherence among people living with Chronic Hepatitis B. Eligibility Criteria: Peer‐reviewed sources examining adults with Hepatitis B attendance at UK secondary care services. Grey literature was excluded. Sources of Evidence: Searches were performed in CINAHL Ultimate, Medline, Embase, Scopus and APA PsycINFO. Data were charted using a structured data extraction form and synthesised narratively. Eleven studies met the inclusion criteria. Identified barriers included patient‐related factors (e.g., limited health literacy, stigmatisation, competing priorities), system‐level challenges (e.g., appointment scheduling and accessibility) and cultural or language barriers. Psychological factors, including fear of diagnosis and treatment side effects, were also reported. Reported strategies included patient education, culturally tailored interventions, reminder systems (e.g., SMS and telephone calls) and integrated care models involving community outreach. Non‐attendance among people with chronic Hepatitis B in secondary care is influenced by a complex interplay of personal, social and systemic factors. Interventions that address multiple barriers, particularly those that incorporate culturally sensitive approaches and reminder systems, may improve engagement. Further research is needed to co‐design and evaluate interventions with affected communities.

papers.title: Self-reported hepatitis B diagnoses and vaccination history in trans and non-binary communities in Germany, the TASG-study* 2022
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: In Germany, little is known about hepatitis B (HepB) prevalence and vaccination coverage among transgender and non-binary people (TNBP), a WHO-defined viral hepatitis key population. Our study aimed to assess self-reported HepB diagnoses, self-reported positive vaccination history, and potential predictors for a positive vaccination history in a subset of participants for whom the German standing committee on vaccination recommend HepB vaccination. METHODS: We analysed data from a 2022 cross-sectional online survey of TNBP in Germany. We calculated percentages and prevalence ratios (PR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI). Predictors of a positive vaccination history among participants potentially recommended for HepB vaccination (e.g. > 1 sexual partner in the last 12 months, people who inject drugs) were identified using a bootstrapped stepwise selection procedure. RESULTS: We analysed the answers from 2,358 participants. Of these, 0.6% (13/2,358) reported previous HepB diagnosis and the proportion of self-reported positive vaccination history was 56.3% (1,225/2,175). Positive vaccination history varied across subgroups, with higher proportions among participants identifying on the male spectrum than on the female (PR: 1.29; 95% CI: 1.14, 1.47) or non-binary spectrum (PR: 1.27; 95% CI: 1.13, 1.44), participants with higher education levels compared to lower (PR: 1.44, 95% CI: 1.26, 1.68), and in big cities compared to rural areas (PR: 1.22, 95% CI: 1.07, 1.41). Overall, 550 (21.7%) participants were identified as potentially being recommended for HepB vaccination, with a total of 213 participants reporting a negative HepB vaccination history. 65% of these 213 participants were younger than 30 years and should have received the recommended childhood HepB vaccination. The proportion of positive vaccination history increased with the number of hepatitis facts known. The bootstrapped stepwise selection procedure identified knowledge of hepatitis facts as potential predictor for a positive vaccination history (relative selection frequency: 100%). CONCLUSION: Self-reported HepB diagnoses were rare among participants and comparable to prevalence estimates in the general population in Germany. To reduce the number of TNBP with unmet vaccination needs and to improve vaccine uptake in this population, gaps in knowledge and lived experiences of TNBP need to be considered in the planning and implementation of targeted interventions. The collection of reliable data is essential on the road to achieve elimination by 2030.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该研究重点关注德国跨性别者和非二元性别人群 (TNBP) 中自我报告的乙型肝炎 (HepB) 诊断和 疫苗接种 病史。核心问题是评估 HepB 诊断的 患病率 和该人群中的 疫苗接种 覆盖率,并在推荐的 HepB 疫苗接种 患者中确定 疫苗接种 阳性病史的潜在预测因子。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究是 2022 年德国 TNBP 的横断面在线调查。使用 患病率 比率 (PR) 和 95% 置信区间 (CI) 分析数据。使用引导逐步选择程序来识别正 疫苗接种 历史的预测因子。该分析包括 2,358 名参与者的回复。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 参与者中自我报告的 HepB 诊断很少,0.6% (13/2,358) 报告之前有过 诊断。自我报告阳性疫苗接种病史的比例为56.3%(1,225/2,175)。不同亚组的积极 疫苗接种 历史各不相同,与农村地区相比,男性、受教育程度较高的参与者以及大城市参与者的比例较高。随着已知肝炎事实数量的增加,疫苗接种 病史阳性的比例也随之增加。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该研究未提供影响 HepB 感染或 疫苗接种 结果的生物或遗传因素的信息。它还没有解决 HepB 基因型对疾病进展或 疫苗 疗效的潜在影响。对自我报告数据的依赖可能会引入偏差,并且该研究没有探讨 TNBP 中 疫苗接种 率低背后的原因。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 为了减少未满足 疫苗接种 需求的 TNBP 数量并提高 疫苗 的吸收率,在规划和实施有针对性的干预措施时应考虑 TNBP 知识和生活经验的差距。收集可靠数据对于到 2030 年消除 HepB 至关重要。

papers.title: Precision switching from entecavir to tenofovir alafenamide in chronic hepatitis B: matching the patient phenotype to efficacy, safety, and value: a narrative review.
papers.abstract: Switching patients who are virologically stable with chronic hepatitis B from entecavir to tenofovir alafenamide has become routine in Korea; however, the literature has established whether switching works at the population level rather than at the patient level. This review reframes this decision as one of candidate selection. Integrating a 2026 Korean multicenter randomized trial with 2023 to 2025 real-world and pharmacoeconomic data shows that in patients who are fully suppressed, the switch is noninferior and safe but adds little, and the analysis separates evidence generated against tenofovir disoproxil fumarate from the sparser entecavir-controlled evidence on which switching decisions must rest. Five phenotypes with a favorable benefit-risk profile are then defined-low-level viremia or partial virologic response, declining estimated glomerular filtration rate or early tubular injury, bone loss or fracture risk, entecavir or multidrug resistance, and planned or confirmed pregnancy-alongside two conditional situations: decompensated cirrhosis, where routine switching is unnecessary unless renal or bone disease coexists, and high cardiovascular risk, which requires lipid monitoring rather than exclusion. Each phenotype is mapped to the 2026 Korean Association for the Study of the Liver guideline and to Korean reimbursement criteria revised in November 2025, graded for certainty, and consolidated into one algorithm that transfers across health systems because the phenotypes are internationally recognized.

papers.title_original: Precision switching from entecavir to tenofovir alafenamide in chronic hepatitis B: matching the patient phenotype to efficacy, safety, and value: a narrative review.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines precision switching from entecavir to tenofovir alafenamide in patients with chronic hepatitis B who are virologically stable, reframing the decision as one of candidate selection rather than population-level efficacy (A1, A2). The central question is whether switching is safe and noninferior in specific patient phenotypes, excluding general population-level outcomes.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review integrates a 2026 Korean multicenter randomized trial with 2023 to 2025 real-world and pharmacoeconomic data, separating evidence generated against tenofovir disoproxil fumarate from sparser entecavir-controlled evidence (A3). It maps phenotypes to the 2026 Korean Association for the Study of the Liver guideline and Korean reimbursement criteria revised in November 2025, grading certainty and consolidating findings into an algorithm (A5).
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: In patients fully suppressed, switching from entecavir to tenofovir alafenamide is noninferior and safe but adds little clinical benefit (A3). The review identifies five phenotypes with a favorable benefit-risk profile: low-level viremia or partial virologic response, declining estimated glomerular filtration rate or early tubular injury, bone loss or fracture risk, entecavir or multidrug resistance, and planned or confirmed pregnancy (A4).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence base is limited by the sparsity of entecavir-controlled trials on which switching decisions must rest, with most data derived from tenofovir disoproxil fumarate comparisons rather than entecavir (A3). The review does not address long-term outcomes such as hepatocellular carcinoma incidence or cirrhosis progression following the switch.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Future research should prioritize entecavir-controlled randomized trials to strengthen evidence for switching decisions (A3). Clinicians should apply phenotype-specific algorithms to guide switching, incorporating renal, bone, resistance, and pregnancy considerations, while monitoring lipid profiles in high cardiovascular risk patients (A4).

analysis.summary_en: This narrative review reframes the switch from entecavir to tenofovir alafenamide in chronic hepatitis B as a patient-level candidate selection problem rather than a population-level efficacy question. It synthesizes a 2026 Korean multicenter randomized trial with 2023–2025 real-world and pharmacoeconomic data, concluding that in fully suppressed patients, the switch is noninferior and safe but offers minimal additional benefit. Five phenotypes with favorable benefit-risk profiles are defined: low-level viremia or partial response, renal impairment, bone loss risk, resistance, and pregnancy. The review maps these phenotypes to Korean guidelines and reimbursement criteria, consolidating them into an algorithm transferable across health systems. Key gaps include the lack of entecavir-controlled evidence and limited data on long-term outcomes such as hepatocellular carcinoma.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述检查了病毒学稳定的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者从恩替卡韦换为替诺福韦艾拉酚胺的精确度,将这一决定重新定义为候选药物选择之一,而不是人群水平疗效(A1、A2)。核心问题是,在排除一般人群水平结果的情况下,转换对于特定患者表型是否安全且非劣质。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述将 2026 年韩国多中心随机试验与 2023 年至 2025 年现实世界和药物经济学数据整合起来,将针对富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯的证据与稀疏的恩替卡韦对照证据区分开来 (A3)。它将表型映射到 2026 年韩国肝脏研究协会指南和 2025 年 11 月修订的韩国报销标准,对确定性进行分级并将结果合并到算法中 (A5)。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在完全抑制的患者中,从恩替卡韦换为替诺福韦艾拉酚胺并不劣质且安全,但几乎没有增加临床益处 (A3)。该综述确定了五种具有有利获益-风险特征的表型:低水平病毒血症或部分病毒学应答、估计肾小球滤过率下降或早期肾小管损伤、骨质流失或骨折风险、恩替卡韦或多药耐药性以及计划或确认妊娠(A4)。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 证据基础受到恩替卡韦对照试验稀疏性的限制,必须根据这些试验做出转换决定,大多数数据来自富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯比较,而不是恩替卡韦 (A3)。该综述并未涉及长期结果,例如肝细胞癌 发病率 或转换后的肝硬化进展。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 未来的研究应优先考虑恩替卡韦对照随机试验,以加强转换决策的证据(A3)。临床医生应应用表型特异性算法来指导转换,纳入肾脏、骨骼、抵抗和妊娠考虑因素,同时监测高心血管风险患者的血脂状况 (A4)。

analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence base is limited by the sparsity of entecavir-controlled trials on which switching decisions must rest, with most data derived from tenofovir disoproxil fumarate comparisons rather than entecavir (A3). The review does not address long-term outcomes such as hepatocellular carcinoma incidence or cirrhosis progression following the switch.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: Future research should prioritize entecavir-controlled randomized trials to strengthen evidence for switching decisions (A3). Clinicians should apply phenotype-specific algorithms to guide switching, incorporating renal, bone, resistance, and pregnancy considerations, while monitoring lipid profiles in high cardiovascular risk patients (A4).

papers.title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 中从恩替卡韦到替诺福韦艾拉酚胺的精确切换:将患者表型与疗效、安全性和价值相匹配:叙述性回顾。
papers.source_body_en: Switching patients who are virologically stable with chronic hepatitis B from entecavir to tenofovir alafenamide has become routine in Korea; however, the literature has established whether switching works at the population level rather than at the patient level. This review reframes this decision as one of candidate selection. Integrating a 2026 Korean multicenter randomized trial with 2023 to 2025 real-world and pharmacoeconomic data shows that in patients who are fully suppressed, the switch is noninferior and safe but adds little, and the analysis separates evidence generated against tenofovir disoproxil fumarate from the sparser entecavir-controlled evidence on which switching decisions must rest. Five phenotypes with a favorable benefit-risk profile are then defined-low-level viremia or partial virologic response, declining estimated glomerular filtration rate or early tubular injury, bone loss or fracture risk, entecavir or multidrug resistance, and planned or confirmed pregnancy-alongside two conditional situations: decompensated cirrhosis, where routine switching is unnecessary unless renal or bone disease coexists, and high cardiovascular risk, which requires lipid monitoring rather than exclusion. Each phenotype is mapped to the 2026 Korean Association for the Study of the Liver guideline and to Korean reimbursement criteria revised in November 2025, graded for certainty, and consolidated into one algorithm that transfers across health systems because the phenotypes are internationally recognized.
papers.abstract_zh: 在韩国,将 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒学稳定的患者从恩替卡韦换为替诺福韦艾拉酚胺已成为惯例;然而,文献已经确定转换是否在人群水平而不是在患者水平有效。这次审查将这一决定重新定义为候选人选择之一。将 2026 年韩国多中心随机试验与 2023 年至 2025 年真实世界和药物经济学数据相结合表明,在完全抑制的患者中,转换是非劣效且安全的,但增加很少,并且分析将针对富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯生成的证据与转换决策必须依赖的稀疏恩替卡韦对照证据分开。然后定义具有有利获益-风险特征的五种表型——低水平病毒血症或部分病毒学应答、估计肾小球滤过率下降或早期肾小管损伤、骨质流失或骨折风险、恩替卡韦或多药耐药性、计划或确认怀孕——以及两种条件情况:失代偿性肝硬化,除非肾脏或骨疾病共存,否则不需要常规转换;以及高心血管风险,需要血脂监测而不是排除。每种表型都映射到 2026 年韩国肝脏研究协会指南和 2025 年 11 月修订的韩国报销标准,进行确定性分级,并整合到一种可跨卫生系统转移的算法中,因为这些表型得到了国际认可。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述检查了病毒学稳定的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者从恩替卡韦换为替诺福韦艾拉酚胺的精确度,将这一决定重新定义为候选药物选择之一,而不是人群水平疗效(A1、A2)。核心问题是,在排除一般人群水平结果的情况下,转换对于特定患者表型是否安全且非劣质。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述将 2026 年韩国多中心随机试验与 2023 年至 2025 年现实世界和药物经济学数据整合起来,将针对富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯的证据与稀疏的恩替卡韦对照证据区分开来 (A3)。它将表型映射到 2026 年韩国肝脏研究协会指南和 2025 年 11 月修订的韩国报销标准,对确定性进行分级并将结果合并到算法中 (A5)。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在完全抑制的患者中,从恩替卡韦换为替诺福韦艾拉酚胺并不劣质且安全,但几乎没有增加临床益处 (A3)。该综述确定了五种具有有利获益-风险特征的表型:低水平病毒血症或部分病毒学应答、估计肾小球滤过率下降或早期肾小管损伤、骨质流失或骨折风险、恩替卡韦或多药耐药性以及计划或确认妊娠(A4)。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 证据基础受到恩替卡韦对照试验稀疏性的限制,必须根据这些试验做出转换决定,大多数数据来自富马酸替诺福韦二吡呋酯比较,而不是恩替卡韦 (A3)。该综述并未涉及长期结果,例如肝细胞癌 发病率 或转换后的肝硬化进展。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 未来的研究应优先考虑恩替卡韦对照随机试验,以加强转换决策的证据(A3)。临床医生应应用表型特异性算法来指导转换,纳入肾脏、骨骼、抵抗和妊娠考虑因素,同时监测高心血管风险患者的血脂状况 (A4)。

papers.title: BEAT-B Study (Behavior, Aspirations, and Treatment Needs): A Mixed-Methods Study of Patient Values, Preferences, and Barriers to Care Among People Living With Chronic Hepatitis B in South and Southeast Asia.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Chronic hepatitis B (HBV) infections have significant challenges in treatment uptake and adherence due to sociocultural barriers, healthcare system inefficiencies, and economic constraints. The evidence to decision framework highlights the importance of understanding patient values and preferences to align evidence‐based policies with the “treat all” approach. Methods This mixed‐methods study included a cross‐sectional survey in five South Asian countries and qualitative data collection through focus group discussions and interviews. Qualitative data explored patient perceptions, barriers, and facilitators in the care continuum, employing thematic analysis. Quantitative data analyzed demographic, socioeconomic, and clinical determinants of treatment uptake and adherence. Findings Qualitative analysis identified key themes, such as the psychological burden of living with HBV, the aspiration for treatment to protect loved ones, and the critical role of clear guidance and social support in facilitating care. Quantitative findings revealed that higher education levels (OR: 2.0; 95% CI: 1.3–3.1), family support (OR: 1.9; 95% CI: 1.3–2.8), and urban residence (OR: 1.7; 95% CI: 1.1–2.5) were significant predictors of treatment uptake. A significant gap in the knowledge and understanding of the chronic nature of HBV among patients, with only 20.5% recognizing it as a long‐term condition and need for family counseling, was noted. Interpretation These findings highlight the importance of incorporating patient values and lived experiences into HBV care models and policy development. Simplified care pathways, strengthened counseling, enhanced family engagement, and improved affordability may help address barriers to treatment uptake and retention in care.

papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Background Chronic hepatitis B (HBV) infections have significant challenges in treatment uptake and adherence due to sociocultural barriers, healthcare system inefficiencies, and economic constraints. Methods This mixed‐methods study included a cross‐sectional survey in five South Asian countries and qualitative data collection through focus group discussions and interviews. Qualitative data explored patient perceptions, barriers, and facilitators in the care continuum, employing thematic analysis. Quantitative data analyzed demographic, socioeconomic, and clinical determinants of treatment uptake and adherence. Quantitative findings revealed that higher education levels (OR: 2.0; 95% CI: 1.3–3.1), family support (OR: 1.9; 95% CI: 1.3–2.8), and urban residence (OR: 1.7; 95% CI: 1.1–2.5) were significant predictors of treatment uptake. Interpretation These findings highlight the importance of incorporating patient values and lived experiences into HBV care models and policy development. papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 由于社会文化障碍、医疗保健系统效率低下和经济限制,慢性乙型肝炎 (HBV) 感染在 治疗 的吸收和依从性方面面临重大挑战。决策框架的证据强调了了解患者价值观和偏好的重要性,以使循证政策与“治疗所有人”的方法保持一致。方法 这项混合方法研究包括对五个南亚国家的横断面调查以及通过焦点小组讨论和访谈收集的定性数据。定性数据采用主题分析,探讨了患者在护理连续体中的看法、障碍和促进因素。定量数据分析了 治疗 摄取和依从性的人口、社会经济和临床决定因素。结果 定性分析确定了关键主题,例如乙型肝炎病毒感染者的心理负担、治疗 保护亲人的愿望,以及明确的指导和社会支持在促进护理方面的关键作用。定量研究结果显示,高等教育水平(OR:2.0;95% CI:1.3-3.1)、家庭支持(OR:1.9;95% CI:1.3-2.8)和城市居住(OR:1.7;95% CI:1.1-2.5)是 治疗 吸收的显着预测因素。人们注意到,患者对乙型肝炎慢性性质的认识和理解存在显着差距,只有 20.5% 的患者认为这是一种长期疾病,需要家庭咨询。解释 这些发现强调了将患者价值观和生活经历纳入乙肝护理模式和政策制定的重要性。简化护理途径、加强咨询、增强家庭参与和提高负担能力可能有助于解决 治疗 接受和保留护理的障碍。

papers.title: Hepatitis B and C Prevention, Screening, and Diagnostic Services at HIV Treatment Sites: International Epidemiology Databases to Evaluate AIDS.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Prevention, screening, and diagnostic services for hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) can prevent morbidity and mortality in people receiving HIV care. However, there is limited information about the availability of HBV and HCV services at HIV clinics globally. METHODS: The International epidemiology Databases to Evaluate AIDS (IeDEA) conducted surveys of service delivery and practices at participating HIV treatment centers from 7 regions. We used 2023 survey data to measure availability of HBV vaccination, HBV and HCV screening, HBV surface antigen (HBsAg), HBV DNA, HCV antibody, and HCV RNA testing. Multivariable logistic regression models were used to test associations of site characteristics with HBV and HCV services. RESULTS: HBV vaccination was available on-site at 67.7% of 204 HIV treatment sites. Screening for HBV and HCV at HIV care enrollment was reported by 72.1% and 50% of sites, respectively. HBsAg, HBV DNA, HCV antibody, and HCV RNA testing were available on-site at 77%, 47.6%, 61.8%, and 44.6% of sites, respectively. Sites serving predominately rural (vs. urban) populations were less likely to report on-site availability of HBV DNA [odds ratio (OR):0.07; 95% confidence interval: 0.01 to 0.68; P = 0.02], HCV antibody (OR = 0.18; 95% CI: 0.04 to 0.92; P = 0.04), and HCV RNA (OR = 0.10; 95% CI: 0.01 to 0.90; P = 0.04) testing. CONCLUSION: Life-saving services such as HBV vaccination, HBsAg, and HCV antibody testing were available on-site at most HIV treatment sites participating in the IeDEA network. Lower availability at rural sites suggests that expansion of services is important to eliminate HBV and HCV as public health problems in people receiving HIV care.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the public-health problem that morbidity and mortality from hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) remain high among people receiving HIV care, despite the availability of effective prevention and diagnostic services. The authors identified a knowledge gap regarding the global availability of HBV and HCV services at HIV clinics.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The International epidemiology Databases to Evaluate AIDS (IeDEA) conducted a cross-sectional survey of service delivery and practices at 204 HIV treatment centers across seven global regions in 2023.
analysis.methods: The survey measured on-site availability of HBV vaccination, HBV and HCV screening, and specific tests (HBsAg, HBV DNA, HCV antibody, HCV RNA). Multivariable logistic regression models were used to test associations between site characteristics and the availability of HBV and HCV services.
analysis.main_results: HBV vaccination was available on-site at 67.7% of sites, screening for HBV and HCV at enrollment was reported by 72.1% and 50% of sites, respectively, and HBsAg, HBV DNA, HCV antibody, and HCV RNA testing were available on-site at 77%, 47.6%, 61.8%, and 44.6% of sites, respectively. Sites serving predominantly rural populations were less likely to offer on-site HBV DNA (OR 0.07; 95% CI 0.01–0.68; P=0.02), HCV antibody (OR 0.18; 95% CI 0.04–0.92; P=0.04), and HCV RNA (OR 0.10; 95% CI 0.01–0.90; P=0.04) testing.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as showing that life-saving HBV and HCV services were available on-site at most participating HIV treatment sites, but lower availability in rural settings highlights a service gap that could impede elimination efforts.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that expanding HBV and HCV services, particularly in rural areas, is critical to achieving elimination goals among people receiving HIV care.

papers.title_zh: HIV 治疗 网站的乙型和丙型肝炎预防、筛查和诊断服务:评估艾滋病的国际 流行病学 数据库。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Prevention, screening, and diagnostic services for hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) can prevent morbidity and mortality in people receiving HIV care. However, there is limited information about the availability of HBV and HCV services at HIV clinics globally. METHODS: The International epidemiology Databases to Evaluate AIDS (IeDEA) conducted surveys of service delivery and practices at participating HIV treatment centers from 7 regions. We used 2023 survey data to measure availability of HBV vaccination, HBV and HCV screening, HBV surface antigen (HBsAg), HBV DNA, HCV antibody, and HCV RNA testing. Multivariable logistic regression models were used to test associations of site characteristics with HBV and HCV services. RESULTS: HBV vaccination was available on-site at 67.7% of 204 HIV treatment sites. Screening for HBV and HCV at HIV care enrollment was reported by 72.1% and 50% of sites, respectively. HBsAg, HBV DNA, HCV antibody, and HCV RNA testing were available on-site at 77%, 47.6%, 61.8%, and 44.6% of sites, respectively. Sites serving predominately rural (vs. urban) populations were less likely to report on-site availability of HBV DNA [odds ratio (OR):0.07; 95% confidence interval: 0.01 to 0.68; P = 0.02], HCV antibody (OR = 0.18; 95% CI: 0.04 to 0.92; P = 0.04), and HCV RNA (OR = 0.10; 95% CI: 0.01 to 0.90; P = 0.04) testing. CONCLUSION: Life-saving services such as HBV vaccination, HBsAg, and HCV antibody testing were available on-site at most HIV treatment sites participating in the IeDEA network. Lower availability at rural sites suggests that expansion of services is important to eliminate HBV and HCV as public health problems in people receiving HIV care.

papers.title: Opportunistic Screening for Hepatitis B and C in Primary Care Using a Reflex Testing System: A Microelimination Model.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infections remain a significant public health concern. Achieving the World Health Organization (WHO) elimination targets by 2030 requires more effective detection strategies than risk factor-based screening. This study evaluates an opportunistic screening program implemented in Primary Care, incorporating an automated diagnostic and referral pathway. PATIENTS AND METHODS: Prospective study of universal HBsAg and anti-HCV screening conducted in a Primary Care center in Barcelona. Adults requiring a blood test for any reason between February 2023 and February 2025 were included. Positive cases were directly referred to the Hepatology Department through an automated care pathway. RESULTS: A total of 3,103 individuals were screened (41% male; mean age 51 years). The prevalence of anti-HCV positivity was 2.0%, with 0.35% having active infection; 82% of viremic patients initiated antiviral treatment. HBsAg prevalence was 0.8%, and 92% of referred cases attended specialist care; 17% initiated treatment. A higher number of risk factors was associated with anti-HCV positivity, whereas no predictors of HBsAg positivity were identified. Notably, 45% of patients with detectable HCV RNA and 44% of HBsAg-positive individuals had neither recognized risk factors nor elevated ALT levels. CONCLUSIONS: Automated opportunistic screening in Primary Care is feasible and effective, identifying HBV and HCV infections that would likely remain undetected using risk factor-based screening strategies. This integrated approach may contribute substantially to the micro-elimination of viral hepatitis.

papers.title_zh: 使用反射测试系统在初级保健中对乙型和丙型肝炎进行机会性筛查:微消除模型。
papers.source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infections remain a significant public health concern. Achieving the World Health Organization (WHO) elimination targets by 2030 requires more effective detection strategies than risk factor-based screening. This study evaluates an opportunistic screening program implemented in Primary Care, incorporating an automated diagnostic and referral pathway. PATIENTS AND METHODS: Prospective study of universal HBsAg and anti-HCV screening conducted in a Primary Care center in Barcelona. Adults requiring a blood test for any reason between February 2023 and February 2025 were included. Positive cases were directly referred to the Hepatology Department through an automated care pathway. RESULTS: A total of 3,103 individuals were screened (41% male; mean age 51 years). The prevalence of anti-HCV positivity was 2.0%, with 0.35% having active infection; 82% of viremic patients initiated antiviral treatment. HBsAg prevalence was 0.8%, and 92% of referred cases attended specialist care; 17% initiated treatment. A higher number of risk factors was associated with anti-HCV positivity, whereas no predictors of HBsAg positivity were identified. Notably, 45% of patients with detectable HCV RNA and 44% of HBsAg-positive individuals had neither recognized risk factors nor elevated ALT levels. CONCLUSIONS: Automated opportunistic screening in Primary Care is feasible and effective, identifying HBV and HCV infections that would likely remain undetected using risk factor-based screening strategies. This integrated approach may contribute substantially to the micro-elimination of viral hepatitis.

papers.title: Differential Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Glycan Isomer Kinetics Between Tenofovir Alafenamide and Entecavir: Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Stratification in Hepatitis B e Antigen-Positive Patients.
papers.abstract: Nucleos(t)ide analog (NA) therapy suppresses hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA, but residual hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk persists. O-glycosylated hepatitis B surface antigen glycan isomer (HBsAgGi) uniquely reflects virion burden. We evaluated the impact of tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) versus entecavir (ETV) on 48-week HBsAgGi kinetics and its utility in stratifying HCC risk in 90 NA-naïve patients (ETV: 73; TAF: 17). A favourable response was defined as a reduction or maintenance of low HBsAgGi levels. TAF independently predicted a favourable response compared with ETV (penalised odds ratio 3.60, p = 0.030). A significant interaction occurred between HBeAg status and HBsAgGi response in relation to HCC development (p = 0.038). In HBeAg-positive patients, a poor response was associated with increased HCC risk (hazard ratio 7.34, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.96-20.35, p = 0.001); however, the exact magnitude warrants cautious interpretation due to wide CIs. This association was absent in HBeAg-negative cases. Adding HBsAgGi response to the aMAP score improved long-term HCC prediction exclusively in the HBeAg-positive cohort. As the assay targets genotype C-specific O-glycosylation, the findings cannot be generalised to genotypes A, B, or D. In conclusion, on-treatment HBsAgGi response is a specific surrogate marker for stratifying residual HCC risk in HBeAg-positive patients, and TAF is more effective than ETV in inducing these favourable kinetics.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Despite nucleos(t)ide analog therapy suppressing HBV DNA, residual hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk persists, creating a need for better risk-stratification markers. The study asked whether on-treatment hepatitis B surface antigen glycan isomer (HBsAgGi) kinetics could distinguish HCC risk and whether tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) outperforms entecavir (ETV) in modulating these kinetics.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a prospective cohort study of 90 NA-naïve chronic hepatitis B patients initiating either TAF (n=17) or ETV (n=73) and followed for 48 weeks. The population comprised HBeAg-positive and HBeAg-negative adults receiving standard-of-care antiviral therapy.
analysis.methods: HBsAgGi was quantified using a genotype C-specific O-glycosylation assay; a favourable response was defined as reduction or maintenance of low HBsAgGi levels. Logistic regression with penalised estimation evaluated predictors of favourable HBsAgGi kinetics, and Cox models assessed HCC risk associations.
analysis.main_results: TAF independently predicted a favourable HBsAgGi response versus ETV (penalised odds ratio 3.60, p=0.030). In HBeAg-positive patients, poor HBsAgGi response was associated with increased HCC risk (hazard ratio 7.34, 95% CI 1.96–20.35, p=0.001), whereas no association was observed in HBeAg-negative patients.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret on-treatment HBsAgGi response as a specific surrogate marker for residual HCC risk in HBeAg-positive patients and conclude that TAF induces more favourable HBsAgGi kinetics than ETV. This is the first report linking HBsAgGi kinetics to HCC risk stratification during NA therapy.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that incorporating HBsAgGi response into existing HCC risk scores (e.g., aMAP) could refine long-term risk prediction in HBeAg-positive patients. They also imply a potential advantage of TAF over ETV in reducing HCC risk via improved HBsAgGi kinetics.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The genotype C-specific assay limits generalisability to other HBV genotypes. The wide confidence intervals around the HCC hazard ratio warrant cautious interpretation, and the study’s modest sample size and single-centre design constrain external validity. Overall evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This prospective cohort study of 90 NA-naïve chronic hepatitis B patients found that tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) more effectively induces favourable hepatitis B surface antigen glycan isomer (HBsAgGi) kinetics over 48 weeks than entecavir (ETV). In HBeAg-positive patients, poor HBsAgGi response was associated with a sevenfold higher hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk (hazard ratio 7.34, 95% CI 1.96–20.35), whereas no association was seen in HBeAg-negative patients. The authors propose HBsAgGi response as a specific surrogate for residual HCC risk stratification and suggest adding it to existing risk scores. However, the genotype C-specific assay restricts generalisability, and the wide confidence intervals and single-centre design limit external validity.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管核(酸)类似物疗法可抑制 HBV DNA,但残留肝细胞癌 (HCC) 风险仍然存在,因此需要更好的风险分层标记。该研究询问 on-治疗 乙型肝炎表面抗原聚糖异构体 (HBsAgGi) 动力学是否可以区分 HCC 风险,以及替诺福韦艾拉酚胺 (TAF) 在调节这些动力学方面是否优于恩替卡韦 (ETV)。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一项前瞻性 队列研究 研究,纳入了 90 名未接受过 NA 的 慢性乙型肝炎 患者,开始使用 TAF (n=17) 或 ETV (n=73),并随访 48 周。该人群包括接受标准护理 抗病毒药物 治疗的 HBeAg 阳性和 HBeAg 阴性成年人。
elements_zh.methods: 使用基因型 C 特异性 O-糖基化测定对 HBsAgGi 进行定量;有利的反应被定义为降低或维持低 HBsAgGi 水平。带有惩罚估计的逻辑回归评估了有利的 HBsAgGi 动力学的预测因子,Cox 模型评估了 HCC 风险关联。
elements_zh.main_results: TAF independently predicted a favourable HBsAgGi response versus ETV (penalised odds ratio 3.60, p=0.030). papers.title: Dysregulated BCR repertoire and metabolic state of HBsAg-specific B cells in chronic hepatitis B revealed by integrated single-cell analysis.
papers.abstract: Background: Humoral immunity targeting hepatitis B virus (HBV) surface antigen (HBsAg) is critical for viral clearance. However, the phenotypic, repertoire, and metabolic features of HBsAg-specific B cells in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remain incompletely defined. Methods: HBsAg-specific B cells were enriched using oligonucleotide-tagged antigen probes and profiled by integrated single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and single-cell B cell receptor sequencing (scBCR-seq) in HBeAg-positive CHB patients, convalescent individuals, and vaccinated healthy controls. Key findings were further evaluated in an independent cohort. Recombinant monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) were generated for functional validation, and ex vivo assays were performed to assess the effects of glutamine modulation on B cell responses. Results: CHB patients exhibited expansion of unswitched memory (USW) and double-negative 1 (DN1) B cell subsets, characterized by impaired immunoglobulin class switching, altered co-stimulatory molecule expression, and increased clonal expansion. B cell receptor (BCR) repertoire analysis revealed biased immunoglobulin heavy chain variable (IGHV) gene usage and elevated somatic hypermutation in specific isotypes. Single-cell metabolic analysis demonstrated increased oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) and reduced glutamine metabolism in CHB HBsAg-specific B cells. Recombinant mAbs showed heterogeneous and conformation-dependent antigen binding, with limited neutralizing activity. In ex vivo assays, glutamine supplementation enhanced antibody production and was associated with reduced OXPHOS signatures and increased interferon signaling, with similar effects observed in total immunoglobulin secretion. Conclusions: HBsAg-specific B cells in CHB display coordinated alterations in subset composition, BCR repertoire, and metabolic state. These findings identify reproducible features of B-cell dysregulation and suggest a potential link between immunometabolic imbalance and impaired humoral responses, providing a framework for further mechanistic investigation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管针对 慢性乙型肝炎 (HBV) 表面抗原 (HBsAg) 的体液免疫对于病毒清除非常重要,但 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 仍然存在,但 CHB 中 HBsAg 特异性 B 细胞的表型、库和代谢特征仍未完全确定。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用寡核苷酸标记的抗原探针以及集成的单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 和单细胞 B 细胞受体测序 (scBCR-seq) 对 HBeAg 阳性 CHB 患者、恢复期个体和接种疫苗的健康对照组的 HBsAg 特异性 B 细胞进行了分析。
elements_zh.methods: 通过 scRNA-seq 和 scBCR-seq 富集和分析 HBsAg 特异性 B 细胞,生成重组单克隆抗体用于功能验证,并通过离体测定评估谷氨酰胺调节对 B 细胞反应的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: CHB 患者表现出未转换记忆和双阴性 1 B 细胞亚群的扩张,并伴有类别转换受损、共刺激分子表达改变、克隆扩张增加、IGHV 基因使用偏向、体细胞超突变增加、氧化磷酸化增加以及 HBsAg 特异性 B 细胞中谷氨酰胺代谢减少。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为 CHB 中 HBsAg 特异性 B 细胞的子集组成、BCR 库和代谢状态的协调变化,识别了 B 细胞失调的可重复特征,并表明免疫代谢失衡与体液反应受损之间存在联系。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能会为调节 B 细胞代谢或增强 CHB 体液免疫的策略提供信息,从而可能改善 疫苗 反应或治疗性抗体的开发。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其重点是 HBeAg 阳性慢性乙型肝炎患者,并且需要进一步进行机制研究以确定免疫代谢失衡与体液反应受损之间的因果关系,因此需要中等可信度。

analysis_en.methods: HBsAg-specific B cells were enriched and analyzed by scRNA-seq and scBCR-seq, recombinant monoclonal antibodies were generated for functional validation, and ex vivo assays assessed the effects of glutamine modulation on B cell responses.
analysis_en.main_results: CHB patients showed expansion of unswitched memory and double-negative 1 B cell subsets with impaired class switching, altered co-stimulatory molecule expression, increased clonal expansion, biased IGHV gene usage, elevated somatic hypermutation, increased oxidative phosphorylation, and reduced glutamine metabolism in HBsAg-specific B cells.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as coordinated alterations in subset composition, BCR repertoire, and metabolic state of HBsAg-specific B cells in CHB, identifying reproducible features of B-cell dysregulation and suggesting a link between immunometabolic imbalance and impaired humoral responses.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings may inform strategies to modulate B-cell metabolism or repertoire to enhance humoral immunity in CHB, potentially improving vaccine responses or therapeutic antibody development.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on HBeAg-positive CHB patients and the need for further mechanistic investigation to establish causality between immunometabolic imbalance and impaired humoral responses, warranting moderate confidence.

papers.title_zh: 通过综合单细胞分析揭示 慢性乙型肝炎 中 HBsAg 特异性 B 细胞失调的 BCR 库和代谢状态。
papers.source_body_en: Background: Humoral immunity targeting hepatitis B virus (HBV) surface antigen (HBsAg) is critical for viral clearance. However, the phenotypic, repertoire, and metabolic features of HBsAg-specific B cells in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remain incompletely defined. Methods: HBsAg-specific B cells were enriched using oligonucleotide-tagged antigen probes and profiled by integrated single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) and single-cell B cell receptor sequencing (scBCR-seq) in HBeAg-positive CHB patients, convalescent individuals, and vaccinated healthy controls. Key findings were further evaluated in an independent cohort. Recombinant monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) were generated for functional validation, and ex vivo assays were performed to assess the effects of glutamine modulation on B cell responses. Results: CHB patients exhibited expansion of unswitched memory (USW) and double-negative 1 (DN1) B cell subsets, characterized by impaired immunoglobulin class switching, altered co-stimulatory molecule expression, and increased clonal expansion. B cell receptor (BCR) repertoire analysis revealed biased immunoglobulin heavy chain variable (IGHV) gene usage and elevated somatic hypermutation in specific isotypes. Single-cell metabolic analysis demonstrated increased oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) and reduced glutamine metabolism in CHB HBsAg-specific B cells. Recombinant mAbs showed heterogeneous and conformation-dependent antigen binding, with limited neutralizing activity. In ex vivo assays, glutamine supplementation enhanced antibody production and was associated with reduced OXPHOS signatures and increased interferon signaling, with similar effects observed in total immunoglobulin secretion. Conclusions: HBsAg-specific B cells in CHB display coordinated alterations in subset composition, BCR repertoire, and metabolic state. These findings identify reproducible features of B-cell dysregulation and suggest a potential link between immunometabolic imbalance and impaired humoral responses, providing a framework for further mechanistic investigation.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:针对 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 表面抗原 (HBsAg) 的体液免疫对于病毒清除至关重要。然而,慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 中 HBsAg 特异性 B 细胞的表型、功能和代谢特征仍未完全确定。方法:使用寡核苷酸标记的抗原探针富集 HBsAg 特异性 B 细胞,并通过集成单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq) 和单细胞 B 细胞受体测序 (scBCR-seq) 对 HBeAg 阳性 CHB 患者、恢复期个体和接种疫苗的健康对照进行分析。独立的 队列研究 进一步评估了主要发现。生成重组单克隆抗体 (mAb) 用于功能验证,并进行离体测定以评估谷氨酰胺调节对 B 细胞反应的影响。结果:CHB 患者表现出未转换记忆 (USW) 和双阴性 1 (DN1) B 细胞亚群的扩张,其特征是免疫球蛋白类别转换受损、共刺激分子表达改变和克隆扩张增加。B 细胞受体 (BCR) 库分析揭示了特定同种型中免疫球蛋白重链可变 (IGHV) 基因使用的偏差和体细胞超突变的增加。单细胞代谢分析表明,CHB HBsAg 特异性 B 细胞中氧化磷酸化 (OXPHOS) 增加,谷氨酰胺代谢减少。重组单克隆抗体表现出异质性和构象依赖性抗原结合,中和活性有限。在离体试验中,补充谷氨酰胺可增强抗体的产生,并与 OXPHOS 特征的减少和干扰素信号传导的增加有关,在总免疫球蛋白分泌中观察到类似的效果。结论:CHB 中的 HBsAg 特异性 B 细胞在亚群组成、BCR 库和代谢状态方面表现出协调变化。这些发现确定了 B 细胞失调的可重复特征,并表明免疫代谢失衡与体液反应受损之间存在潜在联系,为进一步的机制研究提供了框架。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管针对 慢性乙型肝炎 (HBV) 表面抗原 (HBsAg) 的体液免疫对于病毒清除非常重要,但 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 仍然存在,但 CHB 中 HBsAg 特异性 B 细胞的表型、库和代谢特征仍未完全确定。

analysis_zh.main_results: CHB 患者表现出未转换记忆和双阴性 1 B 细胞亚群的扩张,并伴有类别转换受损、共刺激分子表达改变、克隆扩张增加、IGHV 基因使用偏向、体细胞超突变增加、氧化磷酸化增加以及 HBsAg 特异性 B 细胞中谷氨酰胺代谢减少。

papers.title: Prevalence and factors associated with hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positivity in Bugoye Sub-County, Western Uganda
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a major cause of global morbidity and mortality. National serosurveys suggest that Uganda has a prevalence of 4.3%of chronic HBV infection. However, there is limited information regarding the potential determinants for infection. Methods Secondary data from a population-based household survey in the Kasese District were used to estimate HBsAg positivity. From these results, two villages were purposefully selected (i.e., low and high prevalence) for a population-representative household survey and a descriptive cross-sectional study. Descriptive analyses were conducted to characterise HBsAg positivity according to demographic, social-behavioural, clinical, and health-system factors, and spatial kernel density analysis and scan statistics were used to detect high-risk areas. Results A total of 2,067 adults were tested for HBV, of whom 93 were HBsAg-positive, giving an overall seroprevalence of 4.5% (95% CI: 3.6–5.5). In the two selected villages, 286 participants were enrolled, including 125 individuals aged ≥ 15 years and 161 children aged < 15 years. HBsAg positivity was detected in 6 of 125 adults (4.8%) and in no children. Descriptive comparisons suggested that HBsAg-positive participants more frequently reported a history of HBV testing, blood transfusion, and receipt of parenteral medications. A significant spatial cluster of elevated HBV risk was identified in the central region of the study area (RR = 5.22, p = 0.0266). Conclusions The prevalence of HBsAg is highly variable between villages in rural western Uganda. Infection was exclusively found in adults, which suggests. This suggests the benefit of hepatitis vaccination among children and could suggest that vertical and early-life transmission may be less of a risk factor. In adults with HBV, we observed a higher frequency of prior healthcare-associated exposures, which merits further investigation into practices intended to prevent transmission of blood-borne pathogens.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines human hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in Bugoye Sub-County, Western Uganda, focusing on the prevalence of HBsAg positivity and associated demographic, social-behavioural, clinical, and health-system factors among adults and children.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review uses secondary data from a population-based household survey in Kasese District, Uganda, employing a descriptive cross-sectional design with purposeful village selection (low and high prevalence) and spatial analysis to characterize HBsAg positivity.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The overall HBsAg seroprevalence in adults was 4.5% (95% CI: 3.6–5.5), with no detected cases in children. HBsAg-positive participants more frequently reported prior HBV testing, blood transfusion, and receipt of parenteral medications. A significant spatial cluster of elevated HBV risk was identified in the central region of the study area (RR = 5.22, p = 0.0266).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights limited information on determinants of HBV infection in Uganda, particularly the lack of data on vertical and early-life transmission dynamics. The exclusive detection of HBsAg positivity in adults suggests potential underreporting or underdiagnosis in children, warranting further investigation.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings suggest prioritizing hepatitis B vaccination among children and strengthening infection control practices to prevent healthcare-associated HBV transmission, particularly in high-risk spatial clusters.

Among 2,067 adults tested, the overall HBsAg seroprevalence was 4.5% (95% CI: 3.6–5.5), with no cases detected in children. HBsAg-positive participants more frequently reported prior HBV testing, blood transfusion, and parenteral medication receipt. A significant spatial cluster of elevated HBV risk was identified in the central region (RR = 5.22, p = 0.0266). The review underscores gaps in understanding HBV transmission dynamics, particularly vertical and early-life transmission, and emphasizes the need for targeted vaccination and infection control measures.

elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 成人 HBsAg 血清流行率 总体为 4.5%(95% CI:3.6-5.5),未发现儿童病例。HBsAg 阳性参与者更频繁地报告先前的 HBV 检测、输血和接受肠外药物。在研究区域的中心区域发现了一个显着的 HBV 风险升高的空间集群(RR = 5.22,p = 0.0266)。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调了乌干达乙型肝炎病毒感染决定因素的信息有限,特别是缺乏垂直和早期 传播 动态数据。成人 HBsAg 阳性的独家检测表明儿童可能存在漏报或诊断不足的情况,需要进一步调查。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review examines human hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in Bugoye Sub-County, Western Uganda, focusing on the prevalence of HBsAg positivity and associated demographic, social-behavioural, clinical, and health-system factors among adults and children.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review uses secondary data from a population-based household survey in Kasese District, Uganda, employing a descriptive cross-sectional design with purposeful village selection (low and high prevalence) and spatial analysis to characterize HBsAg positivity.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The overall HBsAg seroprevalence in adults was 4.5% (95% CI: 3.6–5.5), with no detected cases in children. HBsAg-positive participants more frequently reported prior HBV testing, blood transfusion, and receipt of parenteral medications. A significant spatial cluster of elevated HBV risk was identified in the central region of the study area (RR = 5.22, p = 0.0266).
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights limited information on determinants of HBV infection in Uganda, particularly the lack of data on vertical and early-life transmission dynamics. The exclusive detection of HBsAg positivity in adults suggests potential underreporting or underdiagnosis in children, warranting further investigation.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The findings suggest prioritizing hepatitis B vaccination among children and strengthening infection control practices to prevent healthcare-associated HBV transmission, particularly in high-risk spatial clusters.

papers.title_zh: 乌干达西部布戈耶县 患病率 和与乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 阳性相关的因素
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a major cause of global morbidity and mortality. National serosurveys suggest that Uganda has a prevalence of 4.3%of chronic HBV infection. However, there is limited information regarding the potential determinants for infection. Methods Secondary data from a population-based household survey in the Kasese District were used to estimate HBsAg positivity. From these results, two villages were purposefully selected (i.e., low and high prevalence) for a population-representative household survey and a descriptive cross-sectional study. Descriptive analyses were conducted to characterise HBsAg positivity according to demographic, social-behavioural, clinical, and health-system factors, and spatial kernel density analysis and scan statistics were used to detect high-risk areas. Results A total of 2,067 adults were tested for HBV, of whom 93 were HBsAg-positive, giving an overall seroprevalence of 4.5% (95% CI: 3.6–5.5). In the two selected villages, 286 participants were enrolled, including 125 individuals aged ≥ 15 years and 161 children aged < 15 years. HBsAg positivity was detected in 6 of 125 adults (4.8%) and in no children. Descriptive comparisons suggested that HBsAg-positive participants more frequently reported a history of HBV testing, blood transfusion, and receipt of parenteral medications. A significant spatial cluster of elevated HBV risk was identified in the central region of the study area (RR = 5.22, p = 0.0266). Conclusions The prevalence of HBsAg is highly variable between villages in rural western Uganda. Infection was exclusively found in adults, which suggests. This suggests the benefit of hepatitis vaccination among children and could suggest that vertical and early-life transmission may be less of a risk factor. In adults with HBV, we observed a higher frequency of prior healthcare-associated exposures, which merits further investigation into practices intended to prevent transmission of blood-borne pathogens.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染是全球发病率和 死亡率 的主要原因。全国血清调查表明,乌干达慢性 HBV 感染的 患病率 为 4.3%。然而,关于感染的潜在决定因素的信息有限。方法 使用来自卡塞塞地区人口家庭调查的二手数据来估计 HBsAg 阳性率。根据这些结果,有目的地选择了两个村庄(即低 患病率 和高 患病率)进行人口代表性住户调查和描述性横断面研究。根据人口、社会行为、临床和卫生系统因素进行描述性分析来表征 HBsAg 阳性,并使用空间核密度分析和扫描统计来检测高风险区域。结果 共有 2,067 名成年人接受了 HBV 检测,其中 93 名 HBsAg 阳性,总体 血清流行率 为 4.5%(95% CI:3.6-5.5)。在两个选定的村庄中,共招募了 286 名参与者,其中 125 名年龄 ≥ 15 岁的个体和 161 名年龄 < 15 岁的儿童。125 名成人中有 6 名 (4.8%) 检测出 HBsAg 阳性,没有儿童检测到。描述性比较表明,HBsAg 阳性参与者更频繁地报告 HBV 检测、输血和接受肠外药物的病史。在研究区域的中心区域发现了一个显着的 HBV 风险升高的空间集群(RR = 5.22,p = 0.0266)。结论 乌干达西部农村各村庄之间的 HBsAg 患病率 差异很大。这表明,感染仅发生在成年人中。这表明 传播 肝炎对儿童有好处,并且可能表明垂直和早年 传播 的危险因素可能较小。在患有 HBV 的成人中,我们观察到先前与医疗保健相关的暴露频率较高,这值得进一步研究旨在预防血源性病原体 传播 的做法。

papers.title: Characterising Hepatitis D Virus in the UK From 2011 to 2021
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Little is known about hepatitis B virus (HBV) and Hepatitis D virus (HDV) coinfection in the UK. HDV screening is recommended among all individuals with HBV, with coinfection associated with increased disease progression. Using data on HDV testing, shared by 11 laboratories in the UK who reported undertaking HDV testing, and national testing data for HBV we established a cohort of individuals tested for HDV, investigating testing pathways, describing characteristics and outcomes of those HDV‐RNA positive to inform targeted interventions for testing, diagnosis and linkage to care. Demographic information, clinical assessments, treatment and recent laboratory results from NHS trusts, and through linkage to national healthcare datasets was collected for HDV‐RNA positive individuals. Between 2011 and 2021, 42% of individuals newly diagnosed with HBV in England were linked to an HDV test. Anti‐HDV positivity was 5.0%, 55.8% were HDV‐RNA tested and 45.7% were ever HDV‐RNA positive. HDV‐RNA positivity in the absence of an anti‐HDV result was 6.4%. Among individuals who were HDV‐RNA positive, 94.3% were non‐UK born, with 24 different primary languages reported, 49% had evidence of treatment, and 48% had evidence of cirrhosis. 10% had died of which 58.4% died of liver disease. In conclusion, our findings indicate that HDV testing in HBV positive individuals in the UK is sub‐optimal against testing guidelines, including RNA testing among those who are anti‐HDV positive. Considerable work is needed to improve the patient care pathway, to ensure patients are appropriately diagnosed, linked and retained in care, with adequate access to treatment.

HDV screening is recommended among all individuals with HBV, with coinfection associated with increased disease progression. Using data on HDV testing, shared by 11 laboratories in the UK who reported undertaking HDV testing, and national testing data for HBV we established a cohort of individuals tested for HDV, investigating testing pathways, describing characteristics and outcomes of those HDV-RNA positive to inform targeted interventions for testing, diagnosis and linkage to care. Demographic information, clinical assessments, treatment and recent laboratory results from NHS trusts, and through linkage to national healthcare datasets was collected for HDV-RNA positive individuals. Between 2011 and 2021, 42% of individuals newly diagnosed with HBV in England were linked to an HDV test. Anti-HDV positivity was 5.0%, 55.8% were HDV-RNA tested and 45.7% were ever HDV-RNA positive. HDV-RNA positivity in the absence of an anti-HDV result was 6.4%. Among individuals who were HDV-RNA positive, 94.3% were non-UK born, with 24 different primary languages reported, 49% had evidence of treatment, and 48% had evidence of cirrhosis. 10% had died of which 58.4% died of liver disease. In conclusion, our findings indicate that HDV testing in HBV positive individuals in the UK is sub-optimal against testing guidelines, including RNA testing among those who are anti-HDV positive. Considerable work is needed to improve the patient care pathway, to ensure patients are appropriately diagnosed, linked and retained in care, with adequate access to treatment.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the lack of knowledge about hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis D virus (HDV) coinfection in the UK, highlighting a gap in understanding the burden and outcomes of HDV among HBV-infected individuals.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A national retrospective cohort study was conducted using HDV testing data from 11 UK laboratories and national HBV testing data to establish a cohort of individuals tested for HDV between 2011 and 2021.
analysis.methods: Demographic, clinical, treatment, and laboratory data were collected from NHS trusts and linked to national healthcare datasets for HDV-RNA positive individuals to describe testing pathways and outcomes.
analysis.main_results: Among individuals newly diagnosed with HBV in England, 42% were linked to an HDV test, anti-HDV positivity was 5.0%, 55.8% were HDV-RNA tested, and 45.7% were ever HDV-RNA positive, with 6.4% HDV-RNA positive in the absence of an anti-HDV result.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that HDV testing in HBV-positive individuals in the UK is sub-optimal compared to guidelines, including RNA testing among anti-HDV positive individuals, indicating a need for improved diagnostic pathways.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the need for targeted interventions to improve HDV testing, diagnosis, and linkage to care among HBV-infected individuals in the UK to reduce disease progression and mortality.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on retrospective data from a limited number of laboratories and lacks detailed information on testing indications, which may introduce selection bias and limit generalisability, warranting a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This UK study assessed HDV testing and outcomes among HBV-infected individuals from 2011 to 2021 using national laboratory and healthcare datasets. It found that only 42% of newly diagnosed HBV cases were linked to HDV testing, with 5.0% anti-HDV positivity and 45.7% ever HDV-RNA positive. Among HDV-RNA positive individuals, 94.3% were non-UK born, 49% had evidence of treatment, 48% had cirrhosis, and 10% had died, with 58.4% of deaths due to liver disease. The authors concluded that HDV testing is sub-optimal relative to guidelines, particularly RNA testing among anti-HDV positive individuals, underscoring the need for improved diagnostic pathways and patient care.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了英国对 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 和丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 双重感染缺乏了解的问题,突显了对 HBV 感染者中 HDV 的负担和结果了解方面的差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用来自 11 个英国实验室的 HDV 检测数据和国家 HBV 检测数据进行了一项全国回顾性 队列研究 研究,以建立 2011 年至 2021 年间接受 HDV 检测的个体的 队列研究。
elements_zh.methods: 人口统计、临床、治疗 和实验室数据是从 NHS 信托机构收集的,并与 HDV-RNA 阳性个体的国家医疗保健数据集相关联,以描述检测途径和结果。
elements_zh.main_results: 在英格兰新诊断出的 HBV 患者中,42% 的人接受过 HDV 检测,抗 HDV 阳性率为 5.0%,55.8% 进行过 HDV-RNA 检测,45.7% 的人曾经呈 HDV-RNA 阳性,其中 6.4% 在没有抗 HDV 结果的情况下 HDV-RNA 呈阳性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,与指南相比,英国 HBV 阳性个体的 HDV 检测效果欠佳,包括抗 HDV 阳性个体的 RNA 检测,这表明需要改进诊断途径。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要采取有针对性的干预措施来改善丁型肝炎病毒检测、诊断,以及与英国 HBV 感染者的护理联系起来,以减少疾病进展和 诊断。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于有限数量的实验室的回顾性数据,缺乏有关测试适应症的详细信息,这可能会引入选择偏差并限制普遍性,需要进行适度的置信度评估。

papers.title: Validation of a Point-Of-Care Ultrasound for Hepatitis Among Front-Line Healthcare Workers Managing Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Zambia.
papers.abstract: To close gaps in implementing care of people with hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in resource-limited settings, we evaluated the accuracy of a novel liver point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) protocol for hepatitis (PUSH) among front-line non-radiology healthcare workers in Zambia. At University Teaching Hospital in Lusaka, Zambia, from March to June 2024, we trained four nurses and six physicians with experience in HBV management, but not in ultrasound (US), in the PUSH protocol, which includes visualizing the liver in three windows (epigastric, subcostal and right transcostal) to identify cirrhosis-suggestive features and liver lesions suspicious for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Then, consecutive adult participants with chronic hepatitis B (PWHB) alone or HBV/HIV coinfection underwent PUSH with operators blinded to clinical data. We evaluated the accuracy of PUSH for significant fibrosis and cirrhosis using transient elastography (TE) as the reference standard test (RST) and for liver lesions that were possible HCC using a comprehensive abdominal ultrasound by an experienced radiographer as the RST. Nonparametric analysis of the receiver operating curve (ROC) for PUSH was adjusted for operator type (doctor vs. nurse), sex and HIV status. Among 197 PWHBs analysed, 69.5% were taking HBV antivirals and 27.9% had HBV/HIV. According to RSTs, 17.7% of PWHBs had significant fibrosis, 11.6% had cirrhosis and 3.5% had liver lesions. PUSH had low accuracy for significant fibrosis, with sensitivity of 8.3% (17.5-41.4), specificity of 100.0% (96.1-100) and an area under the curve (AUROC) of 0.54 (0.43-0.65), moderate accuracy for cirrhosis, with sensitivity of 60.9% (38.5-80.3), specificity of 97.7% (94.2-99.4) and AUROC of 0.79 (0.69-0.89), and higher accuracy for liver lesions, with 85.7% (42.1-99.6) sensitivity, 98.4% (95.5-99.7) specificity, AUROC of 0.92 (0.78-1.00). After an expedited training, front-line nurses and physicians treating HBV in Zambia were able to use PUSH to diagnose cirrhosis with moderate accuracy and liver lesions with high accuracy, although confidence intervals around performance estimates were wide. Liver POCUS including PUSH may be useful in HBV management when laboratory systems and TE are lacking.

At University Teaching Hospital in Lusaka, Zambia, from March to June 2024, we trained four nurses and six physicians with experience in HBV management, but not in ultrasound (US), in the PUSH protocol, which includes visualizing the liver in three windows (epigastric, subcostal and right transcostal) to identify cirrhosis-suggestive features and liver lesions suspicious for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Then, consecutive adult participants with chronic hepatitis B (PWHB) alone or HBV/HIV coinfection underwent PUSH with operators blinded to clinical data. We evaluated the accuracy of PUSH for significant fibrosis and cirrhosis using transient elastography (TE) as the reference standard test (RST) and for liver lesions that were possible HCC using a comprehensive abdominal ultrasound by an experienced radiographer as the RST. Nonparametric analysis of the receiver operating curve (ROC) for PUSH was adjusted for operator type (doctor vs. nurse), sex and HIV status. Among 197 PWHBs analysed, 69.5% were taking HBV antivirals and 27.9% had HBV/HIV. According to RSTs, 17.7% of PWHBs had significant fibrosis, 11.6% had cirrhosis and 3.5% had liver lesions. PUSH had low accuracy for significant fibrosis, with sensitivity of 8.3% (17.5-41.4), specificity of 100.0% (96.1-100) and an area under the curve (AUROC) of 0.54 (0.43-0.65), moderate accuracy for cirrhosis, with sensitivity of 60.9% (38.5-80.3), specificity of 97.7% (94.2-99.4) and AUROC of 0.79 (0.69-0.89), and higher accuracy for liver lesions, with 85.7% (42.1-99.6) sensitivity, 98.4% (95.5-99.7) specificity, AUROC of 0.92 (0.78-1.00). After an expedited training, front-line nurses and physicians treating HBV in Zambia were able to use PUSH to diagnose cirrhosis with moderate accuracy and liver lesions with high accuracy, although confidence intervals around performance estimates were wide. Liver POCUS including PUSH may be useful in HBV management when laboratory systems and TE are lacking.
