analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains under-managed in resource-limited settings due to diagnostic access barriers, prompting the need for accurate point-of-care tools. The study aimed to evaluate whether a novel liver point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) protocol (PUSH) could accurately identify cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) among adults with chronic HBV managed by front-line healthcare workers in Zambia.
analysis.study_design_and_population: At University Teaching Hospital in Lusaka, Zambia, from March to June 2024, four nurses and six physicians with HBV management experience but no ultrasound training were trained in the PUSH protocol, which visualizes the liver in three windows to detect cirrhosis-suggestive features and HCC-suspicious lesions. Consecutive adults with chronic HBV or HBV/HIV coinfection underwent PUSH with operators blinded to clinical data.
analysis.methods: PUSH accuracy for significant fibrosis and cirrhosis was assessed against transient elastography (TE) as the reference standard, while liver lesions were compared to comprehensive abdominal ultrasound by an experienced radiographer. Nonparametric receiver operating curve (ROC) analysis adjusted for operator type, sex, and HIV status was used to evaluate diagnostic performance.
analysis.main_results: Among 197 participants, 17.7% had significant fibrosis, 11.6% had cirrhosis, and 3.5% had liver lesions by reference standards. PUSH showed low accuracy for significant fibrosis (sensitivity 8.3%, specificity 100.0%, AUROC 0.54), moderate accuracy for cirrhosis (sensitivity 60.9%, specificity 97.7%, AUROC 0.79), and high accuracy for liver lesions (sensitivity 85.7%, specificity 98.4%, AUROC 0.92).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that PUSH can diagnose cirrhosis with moderate accuracy and liver lesions with high accuracy after brief training, highlighting its potential utility where laboratory systems and TE are unavailable. They emphasized the novelty of validating a non-radiologist-performed POCUS protocol for HBV-related complications in a resource-limited setting.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings cautiously suggest that PUSH could support decentralized HBV care by enabling front-line providers to screen for cirrhosis and HCC when advanced diagnostics are inaccessible, potentially improving early detection and referral in Zambia.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s small sample size and wide confidence intervals around performance estimates limit precision, and the single-centre design restricts generalizability. Despite these limitations, the evidence is moderate due to the clear target-specific methodology and clinically relevant outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated a novel liver point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) protocol (PUSH) for diagnosing cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) among adults with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in Zambia. After brief training, front-line nurses and physicians used PUSH to assess 197 participants, comparing results to transient elastography (TE) for fibrosis/cirrhosis and comprehensive ultrasound for liver lesions. PUSH showed low accuracy for significant fibrosis (AUROC 0.54) but moderate accuracy for cirrhosis (AUROC 0.79) and high accuracy for liver lesions (AUROC 0.92). The authors conclude that PUSH may be useful for decentralized HBV care where advanced diagnostics are unavailable, though small sample size and wide confidence intervals limit precision.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于诊断访问障碍,慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染在资源有限的环境中仍然管理不善,这促使需要准确的护理点工具。该研究旨在评估新型肝脏即时超声 (POCUS) 方案 (PUSH) 是否能够准确识别赞比亚一线医护人员管理的慢性乙肝成人患者中的肝硬化和肝细胞癌 (HCC)。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 3 月至 6 月,在赞比亚卢萨卡的大学教学医院,四名具有 HBV 管理经验但没有接受过超声培训的护士和六名医生接受了 PUSH 方案的培训,该方案在三个窗口中可视化肝脏,以检测肝硬化提示特征和 HCC 可疑病变。连续患有慢性 HBV 或 HBV/HIV 双重感染的成年人在不了解临床数据的情况下接受了 PUSH。
elements_zh.methods: 以瞬时弹性成像 (TE) 作为参考标准评估显着纤维化和肝硬化的 PUSH 准确性,同时由经验丰富的放射技师将肝脏病变与综合腹部超声进行比较。根据操作者类型、性别和 HIV 状态进行调整的非参数受试者工作曲线 (ROC) 分析用于评估诊断性能。
elements_zh.main_results: 根据参考标准,197 名参与者中,17.7% 患有明显纤维化,11.6% 患有肝硬化,3.5% 患有肝脏病变。PUSH 对显着纤维化的准确性较低(敏感性 8.3%,特异性 100.0%,AUROC 0.54),对肝硬化的准确性中等(敏感性 60.9%,特异性 97.7%,AUROC 0.79),对肝脏病变的准确性较高(敏感性 85.7%,特异性 98.4%,AUROC 0.92)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,经过短暂训练后,PUSH 可以以中等准确度诊断肝硬化,并以较高准确度诊断肝脏病变,这突显了其在实验室系统和 TE 不可用的情况下的潜在用途。他们强调了在资源有限的环境中验证非放射科医生执行的 POCUS 方案针对 HBV 相关并发症的新颖性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现谨慎地表明,PUSH 可以支持分散的 HBV 护理,使一线提供者能够在无法获得高级诊断的情况下筛查肝硬化和 HCC,从而有可能改善赞比亚的早期检测和转诊。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的样本量较小,性能估计的置信区间较宽,限制了精度,而且单中心设计限制了普遍性。尽管存在这些局限性,但由于明确的目标特异性方法和临床相关结果,证据是温和的。

papers.abstract_zh: 为弥合资源有限环境中乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染患者护理实施中的差距,我们评估了一种新型肝脏床旁超声(POCUS)肝炎筛查方案(PUSH)在赞比亚一线非放射科医护人员中的准确性。在2024年3月至6月期间,于赞比亚卢萨卡大学教学医院,我们培训了4名护士和6名有HBV管理经验但无超声(US)经验的医生,采用PUSH方案,包括在三个窗口(上腹部、肋下和右侧肋间)观察肝脏,以识别提示肝硬化的特征及疑似肝细胞癌(HCC)的肝脏病变。随后,连续纳入仅患有乙型肝炎(PWHB)或HBV/HIV合并感染的成年参与者,进行PUSH检查,操作者对临床数据不知情。我们使用瞬时弹性成像(TE)作为参考标准(RST)评估PUSH对显著纤维化和肝硬化的准确性,并使用经验丰富放射技师进行的全面腹部超声作为可能HCC肝脏病变的RST。采用非参数法分析PUSH的受试者工作特征曲线(ROC),并按操作者类型(医生vs护士)、性别和HIV状态进行调整。在197名分析的PWHB中,69.5%正在接受HBV抗病毒药物治疗,27.9%为HBV/HIV合并感染。根据RST结果,17.7%的PWHB存在显著纤维化,11.6%存在肝硬化,3.5%存在肝脏病变。PUSH对显著纤维化的准确性较低,敏感性为8.3%(17.5-41.4),特异性为100.0%(96.1-100),曲线下面积(AUROC)为0.54(0.43-0.65);对肝硬化的准确性为中等,敏感性为60.9%(38.5-80.3),特异性为97.7%(94.2-99.4),AUROC为0.79(0.69-0.89);对肝脏病变的准确性较高,敏感性为85.7%(42.1-99.6),特异性为98.4%(95.5-99.7),AUROC为0.92(0.78-1.00)。在赞比亚,经过快速培训的前线护士和医生能够使用PUSH以中等准确性诊断肝硬化,以高准确性诊断肝脏病变,尽管性能估计的置信区间较宽。在缺乏实验室系统和TE的情况下,包含PUSH的肝脏POCUS可能有助于HBV管理。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于诊断访问障碍,慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染在资源有限的环境中仍然管理不善,这促使需要准确的护理点工具。该研究旨在评估新型肝脏即时超声 (POCUS) 方案 (PUSH) 是否能够准确识别赞比亚一线医护人员管理的慢性乙肝成人患者中的肝硬化和肝细胞癌 (HCC)。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 3 月至 6 月,在赞比亚卢萨卡的大学教学医院,四名具有 HBV 管理经验但没有接受过超声培训的护士和六名医生接受了 PUSH 方案的培训,该方案在三个窗口中可视化肝脏,以检测肝硬化提示特征和 HCC 可疑病变。连续患有慢性 HBV 或 HBV/HIV 双重感染的成年人在不了解临床数据的情况下接受了 PUSH。
analysis_zh.methods: 以瞬时弹性成像 (TE) 作为参考标准评估显着纤维化和肝硬化的 PUSH 准确性,同时由经验丰富的放射技师将肝脏病变与综合腹部超声进行比较。根据操作者类型、性别和 HIV 状态进行调整的非参数受试者工作曲线 (ROC) 分析用于评估诊断性能。
analysis_zh.main_results: 根据参考标准,197 名参与者中,17.7% 患有明显纤维化,11.6% 患有肝硬化,3.5% 患有肝脏病变。PUSH 对显着纤维化的准确性较低(敏感性 8.3%,特异性 100.0%,AUROC 0.54),对肝硬化的准确性中等(敏感性 60.9%,特异性 97.7%,AUROC 0.79),对肝脏病变的准确性较高(敏感性 85.7%,特异性 98.4%,AUROC 0.92)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,经过短暂训练后,PUSH 可以以中等准确度诊断肝硬化,并以较高准确度诊断肝脏病变,这突显了其在实验室系统和 TE 不可用的情况下的潜在用途。他们强调了在资源有限的环境中验证非放射科医生执行的 POCUS 方案针对 HBV 相关并发症的新颖性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现谨慎地表明,PUSH 可以支持分散的 HBV 护理,使一线提供者能够在无法获得高级诊断的情况下筛查肝硬化和 HCC,从而有可能改善赞比亚的早期检测和转诊。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的样本量较小,性能估计的置信区间较宽,限制了精度,而且单中心设计限制了普遍性。尽管存在这些局限性,但由于明确的目标特异性方法和临床相关结果,证据是温和的。

papers.title: What is the impact of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) on outcomes in people living with chronic hepatitis B (CHB)? An umbrella review protocol
papers.abstract: Introduction An estimated 254 million people are living with chronic hepatitis B virus (CHB) and 1.6 billion with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) worldwide. CHB remains a major global health challenge, despite a robust vaccine and suppressive antiviral treatment, and MASLD prevalence is increasing in line with a rise in cardiometabolic risk factors, such as obesity and type 2 diabetes. Thus, understanding the impact of concurrent CHB and MASLD on liver health is important to inform clinical practice and population surveillance. Current literature, including over ten systematic reviews and meta-analyses, yields conflicting evidence about the interplay between CHB and MASLD. This protocol describes a study aiming to critically appraise published systematic reviews investigating the effect of MASLD on liver outcomes in people living with CHB, identify gaps in the available data and assist scientists and clinicians in informing future research design. Methods and analysis We will use umbrella review methodology from the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) to evaluate and synthesise evidence from existing systematic reviews and meta-analysis investigating liver and viral outcomes (fibrosis, cirrhosis, hepatocellular carcinoma, response to antiviral treatment, and impact on CHB biomarkers e.g. hepatitis B surface antigen, hepatitis B e-antigen and viral load) in CHB and MASLD, compared to CHB alone. We will search Ovid Medline, Ovid Embase, PubMed and Web of Science. We will assess methodological quality using the Assessing the Quality of Systematic Reviews-2 (AMSTAR-2) tool, compare study characteristics and present important results. Ethics and dissemination No ethics approval is required as we will use only data from systematic reviews that are already published. Results will be included in a PhD thesis, submitted for consideration for presentation at international conferences and for peer review for publication in a scientific journal. We will endeavour to share results with relevant public and patient organisations. Registration details This umbrella review has been published on PROSPERO (ID CRD420261308282).

analysis.summary_en: This umbrella‐review protocol examines how metabolic dysfunction‐associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) modifies liver and viral outcomes in individuals with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). It will apply Joanna Briggs Institute methods, search major biomedical databases, and evaluate included systematic reviews with the AMSTAR‐2 tool, with registration on PROSPERO. The authors highlight that existing reviews report conflicting results, underscoring a lack of consensus and substantial heterogeneity. Consequently, the protocol aims to pinpoint gaps in the evidence base concerning MASLD’s impact on CHB progression. By clarifying these gaps, the work seeks to inform clinical practice, population surveillance, and prioritize future research directions on this co‐morbidity.

Results will be included in a PhD thesis, submitted for consideration for presentation at international conferences and for peer review for publication in a scientific journal. papers.title: Vorapaxar and aripiprazole suppress hepatitis B virus replication through distinct host signaling pathways
papers.abstract: Abstract Background & Aims Current nucleos(t)ide analogs efficiently suppress hepatitis B virus (HBV) replication but have limited effects on viral transcription from covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA) and integrated HBV DNA. We aimed to identify clinically applicable compounds that directly inhibit HBV transcription by screening FDA-approved drugs. Approach & Results Screening of 1,470 FDA-approved compounds using an HBV enhancer I/X promoter reporter system identified vorapaxar and aripiprazole as potent inhibitors of viral promoter activity. Both compounds suppressed HBV replication in HBV-producing cells, HBV-infected HepG2-hNTCP cells, and primary human hepatocytes. Aripiprazole reduced hepatocyte nuclear factor 4α (HNF4α) protein levels through an ERK/JNK-dependent pathway and inhibited HBV core promoter activity, whereas vorapaxar acted independently of HNF4α. Both compounds suppressed enhancer I/X promoter activity through inhibition of STAT3 signaling. Vorapaxar inhibited PAR-1-mediated SRC, EGFR, and STAT3 activation, while aripiprazole suppressed SRC–STAT3 signaling independently of EGFR. PAR-1 activation enhanced HBV transcription, whereas PAR-1 knockdown reduced promoter activity and viral RNA expression. Both compounds also reduced HBV replication in human liver chimeric mice at clinically relevant exposure levels without apparent severe toxicity. Conclusions Vorapaxar and aripiprazole suppress HBV transcription and replication through distinct host signaling pathways. These findings identify PAR-1–STAT3 signaling as a previously unrecognized regulator of HBV transcription and suggest that host-targeting approaches may complement current therapies by suppressing viral gene expression from both cccDNA and integrated HBV DNA. Impact and implications Current nucleos(t)ide analogues effectively suppress HBV reverse transcription but have limited effects on viral transcription from cccDNA and integrated HBV DNA, highlighting the need for therapies targeting viral gene expression. We identify PAR-1– STAT3 signaling as a previously unrecognized regulator of HBV transcription and demonstrate that two clinically approved drugs, vorapaxar and aripiprazole, suppress HBV replication through distinct host signaling pathways. These findings are relevant to researchers developing host-targeting antivirals and to clinicians seeking complementary therapeutic strategies beyond current nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy. Although further clinical validation and combination studies are required, our results provide a rationale for repurposing approved drugs and for developing transcription-targeting therapies that may complement existing treatments for chronic hepatitis B. Highlights Vorapaxar and aripiprazole suppress HBV through distinct host pathways. Both drugs inhibit HBV replication in vitro and in humanized liver mice. PAR-1 inhibition reduces HBV transcription by blocking SRC/EGFR/STAT3 signaling. PAR-1–STAT3 signaling is a novel regulator of HBV transcription. Host-targeting antiviral therapy complements current HBV treatment.

Approach & Results Screening of 1,470 FDA-approved compounds using an HBV enhancer I/X promoter reporter system identified vorapaxar and aripiprazole as potent inhibitors of viral promoter activity. Both compounds suppressed HBV replication in HBV-producing cells, HBV-infected HepG2-hNTCP cells, and primary human hepatocytes. Aripiprazole reduced hepatocyte nuclear factor 4α (HNF4α) protein levels through an ERK/JNK-dependent pathway and inhibited HBV core promoter activity, whereas vorapaxar acted independently of HNF4α. Both compounds suppressed enhancer I/X promoter activity through inhibition of STAT3 signaling. Vorapaxar inhibited PAR-1-mediated SRC, EGFR, and STAT3 activation, while aripiprazole suppressed SRC–STAT3 signaling independently of EGFR. PAR-1 activation enhanced HBV transcription, whereas PAR-1 knockdown reduced promoter activity and viral RNA expression. Both compounds also reduced HBV replication in human liver chimeric mice at clinically relevant exposure levels without apparent severe toxicity. Conclusions Vorapaxar and aripiprazole suppress HBV transcription and replication through distinct host signaling pathways. These findings identify PAR-1–STAT3 signaling as a previously unrecognized regulator of HBV transcription and suggest that host-targeting approaches may complement current therapies by suppressing viral gene expression from both cccDNA and integrated HBV DNA. Impact and implications Current nucleos(t)ide analogues effectively suppress HBV reverse transcription but have limited effects on viral transcription from cccDNA and integrated HBV DNA, highlighting the need for therapies targeting viral gene expression. We identify PAR-1– STAT3 signaling as a previously unrecognized regulator of HBV transcription and demonstrate that two clinically approved drugs, vorapaxar and aripiprazole, suppress HBV replication through distinct host signaling pathways. These findings are relevant to researchers developing host-targeting antivirals and to clinicians seeking complementary therapeutic strategies beyond current nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy. Although further clinical validation and combination studies are required, our results provide a rationale for repurposing approved drugs and for developing transcription-targeting therapies that may complement existing treatments for chronic hepatitis B. Highlights Vorapaxar and aripiprazole suppress HBV through distinct host pathways. Both drugs inhibit HBV replication in vitro and in humanized liver mice. PAR-1 inhibition reduces HBV transcription by blocking SRC/EGFR/STAT3 signaling. PAR-1–STAT3 signaling is a novel regulator of HBV transcription. Host-targeting antiviral therapy complements current HBV treatment.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Current nucleos(t)ide analogs efficiently suppress hepatitis B virus (HBV) replication but have limited effects on viral transcription from covalently closed circular DNA (cccDNA) and integrated HBV DNA. This study aimed to identify clinically applicable compounds that directly inhibit HBV transcription by screening FDA-approved drugs.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved screening 1,470 FDA-approved compounds using an HBV enhancer I/X promoter reporter system to identify potent inhibitors of viral promoter activity. Both vorapaxar and aripiprazole were found to suppress HBV replication in HBV-producing cells, HBV-infected HepG2-hNTCP cells, and primary human hepatocytes.
analysis.methods: An HBV enhancer I/X promoter reporter system was used to screen 1,470 FDA-approved compounds. The study also included in vitro experiments and testing in human liver chimeric mice to evaluate the effects of vorapaxar and aripiprazole on HBV replication at clinically relevant exposure levels.
analysis.main_results: They also reduced HBV replication in human liver chimeric mice at clinically relevant exposure levels without apparent severe toxicity.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that PAR-1–STAT3 signaling is a novel regulator of HBV transcription, and they demonstrate that two clinically approved drugs, vorapaxar and aripiprazole, suppress HBV replication through distinct host signaling pathways.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings are relevant to researchers developing host-targeting antivirals and to clinicians seeking complementary therapeutic strategies beyond current nucleos(t)ide analogue therapy. They suggest that host-targeting antiviral therapy may complement existing treatments for chronic hepatitis B.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro and in humanized liver mice experiments, and further clinical validation and combination studies are required. The evidence is moderate as it is based on abstract-only data.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the potential of FDA-approved drugs to suppress hepatitis B virus (HBV) transcription and replication. It identifies vorapaxar and aripiprazole as potent inhibitors of HBV promoter activity through distinct host signaling pathways. The research highlights the role of PAR-1–STAT3 signaling in HBV transcription and suggests that host-targeting approaches could complement current nucleos(t)ide analog therapies. The findings are relevant for developing new antiviral strategies but are based on in vitro and animal model data, requiring further clinical validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 目前的核苷类似物可有效抑制 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 复制,但对共价闭合环状 DNA (共价闭合环状DNA) 和整合的 HBV DNA 的病毒转录影响有限。本研究旨在通过筛选 FDA 批准的药物来鉴定直接抑制 HBV 转录的临床适用化合物。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及使用 HBV 增强子 I/X 启动子报告系统筛选 1,470 种 FDA 批准的化合物,以确定病毒启动子活性的有效抑制剂。沃拉帕沙和阿立哌唑均被发现可抑制 HBV 产生细胞、HBV 感染的 HepG2-hNTCP 细胞和原代人肝细胞中的 HBV 复制。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 HBV 增强子 I/X 启动子报告系统筛选 1,470 种 FDA 批准的化合物。该研究还包括体外实验和人肝嵌合小鼠测试,以评估沃拉帕沙和阿立哌唑在临床相关暴露水平下对乙型肝炎病毒复制的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 他们还在临床相关暴露水平下减少了人肝嵌合小鼠中的 HBV 复制,且没有明显的严重毒性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,PAR-1-STAT3 信号传导是 HBV 转录的新型调节因子,他们证明了两种临床批准的药物,沃拉帕沙和阿立哌唑,通过不同的 宿主 信号传导途径抑制 HBV 复制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现与开发 宿主 靶向 抗病毒药物 的研究人员以及寻求当前核苷(酸)类似物治疗之外的补充治疗策略的临床医生相关。他们认为,宿主 靶向 抗病毒药物 疗法可能会补充 慢性乙型肝炎 的现有 治疗。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外和人源化肝小鼠实验,还需要进一步的临床验证和联合研究。证据是温和的,因为它基于仅抽象的数据。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景与目的 目前的核苷类似物可有效抑制 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 复制,但对共价闭合环状 DNA (共价闭合环状DNA) 和整合的 HBV DNA 的病毒转录影响有限。我们的目的是通过筛选 FDA 批准的药物来鉴定直接抑制 HBV 转录的临床适用化合物。方法和结果 使用 HBV 增强子 I/X 启动子报告系统对 1,470 种 FDA 批准的化合物进行筛选,确定沃拉帕沙和阿立哌唑是病毒启动子活性的有效抑制剂。这两种化合物均可抑制 HBV 产生细胞、HBV 感染的 HepG2-hNTCP 细胞和原代人肝细胞中的 HBV 复制。阿立哌唑通过 ERK/JNK 依赖性途径降低肝细胞核因子 4α (HNF4α) 蛋白水平并抑制 HBV 核心启动子活性,而沃拉帕沙的作用独立于 HNF4α。两种化合物均通过抑制 STAT3 信号传导来抑制增强子 I/X 启动子活性。Vorapaxar 抑制 PAR-1 介导的 SRC、EGFR 和 STAT3 激活,而阿立哌唑则独立于 EGFR 抑制 SRC-STAT3 信号传导。PAR-1 激活增强了 HBV 转录,而 PAR-1 敲低则降低了启动子活性和病毒 RNA 表达。这两种化合物还在临床相关暴露水平下减少了人肝嵌合小鼠中的 HBV 复制,且没有明显的严重毒性。结论 Vorapaxar 和阿立哌唑通过不同的 宿主 信号通路抑制 HBV 转录和复制。这些发现将 PAR-1–STAT3 信号转导确定为以前未被识别的 HBV 转录调节因子,并表明 宿主 靶向方法可以通过抑制 共价闭合环状DNA 和整合的 HBV DNA 的病毒基因表达来补充当前的治疗方法。影响和意义 目前的核苷(酸)类似物可有效抑制 HBV 逆转录,但对 共价闭合环状DNA 和整合的 HBV DNA 的病毒转录影响有限,这凸显了针对病毒基因表达的治疗的需要。我们将 PAR-1-STAT3 信号传导确定为以前未被识别的 HBV 转录调节因子,并证明两种临床批准的药物沃拉帕沙和阿立哌唑通过不同的 宿主 信号传导途径抑制 HBV 复制。这些发现与开发 宿主 靶向 抗病毒药物 的研究人员以及寻求当前核苷(酸)类似物治疗之外的补充治疗策略的临床医生相关。尽管还需要进一步的临床验证和联合研究,但我们的结果为重新利用已批准的药物和开发可能补充 慢性乙型肝炎 现有 治疗 的转录靶向疗法提供了理论基础。亮点 Vorapaxar 和阿立哌唑通过不同的 宿主 途径抑制 HBV。这两种药物均能在体外和人源化肝小鼠体内抑制 HBV 复制。PAR-1 抑制通过阻断 SRC/EGFR/STAT3 信号传导来减少 HBV 转录。PAR-1–STAT3 信号传导是 HBV 转录的新型调节因子。宿主 靶向 抗病毒药物 疗法补充了当前的 HBV 治疗。

papers.title: Hepatitis B vaccine-induced immunity among hill tribe and stateless children in northern Thailand
papers.abstract: The aim of this study was to determine the difference in seroprotection between fully and partially vaccinated hill tribe and stateless children aged five years in northern Thailand along with the factors associated with the absence of anti-HBs in these children since vaccine implementation began in 1992. A case–control study was conducted to collect information from hill tribe and stateless individuals living in villages in Mae Fah Luang District, Chiang Rai Province. Children with no prior immunization, delayed immunization, or incomplete hepatitis B vaccination were included. Children who were completely vaccinated were included as controls. A questionnaire was distributed and 3 mL blood samples were collected for the qualitative and quantitative detection of hepatitis B biomarkers. Logistic regression was applied to detect factors associated with the absence of anti-HBs. A total of 188 cases and 188 controls were included in the study; 54% were male, and 54.3% belonged to the Akha group. The overall prevalence of anti-HBs was 59.3%; 55.3% of anti-HBs was detected in children with complete vaccination (with 2 children positive for anti-HBc), and 55.3% was detected in children with incomplete vaccination. Children whose birth weight was <2500 g (AOR = 3.52; 95% CI = 1.39–9.12), whose mother belonged to the Yao group (AOR = 16.90; 95% CI = 2.00–142.57), whose mother practiced Christianity (AOR = 2.30; 95% CI = 1.18–4.46), and whose father was aged 30–39 years (AOR = 2.20; 95% CI = 1.01–4.80) were more likely to exhibit an absence of anti-HBs. The hepatitis B vaccine-induced immune response rate among hill tribe and stateless children remains undesirable, and an effective assessment program is needed to monitor this issue.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the public-health problem of suboptimal hepatitis B vaccine-induced immunity in marginalized hill tribe and stateless children in northern Thailand, where vaccination began in 1992. It aimed to quantify seroprotection differences between fully and partially vaccinated children and to identify factors linked to the absence of anti-HBs antibodies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A case–control study was conducted in villages of Mae Fah Luang District, Chiang Rai Province, enrolling hill tribe and stateless children aged five years. Cases were children with no prior, delayed, or incomplete hepatitis B vaccination, while controls were those who were completely vaccinated.
analysis.methods: A questionnaire was administered and 3 mL blood samples were collected for qualitative and quantitative detection of hepatitis B biomarkers. Logistic regression was used to detect factors associated with the absence of anti-HBs.
analysis.main_results: The overall anti-HBs prevalence was 59.3%, with 55.3% detected in both fully vaccinated and incompletely vaccinated children (2 children positive for anti-HBc among the fully vaccinated).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the low seroprotection rate as undesirable and highlighted maternal Yao ethnicity and low birth weight as strong predictors of anti-HBs absence. They concluded that an effective assessment program is needed to monitor vaccine-induced immunity in these populations.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings indicate that targeted vaccination programs and post-vaccination serosurveillance are warranted for hill tribe and stateless children in northern Thailand to improve hepatitis B immunity and reduce transmission risk.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported vaccination status limit causal inference and may underestimate true seroprotection gaps. The evidence is moderate due to potential selection bias and unmeasured confounders.

analysis.summary_en: This case–control study in northern Thailand evaluated hepatitis B vaccine-induced immunity among hill tribe and stateless children aged five years, comparing fully and partially vaccinated groups. Using questionnaires and blood biomarker testing, the authors found an overall anti-HBs prevalence of 59.3%, with no meaningful difference between fully and incompletely vaccinated children. Logistic regression identified low birth weight, maternal Yao ethnicity, maternal Christianity, and paternal age 30–39 years as factors associated with the absence of anti-HBs. The authors concluded that vaccine-induced immune responses remain suboptimal and called for enhanced monitoring and targeted immunization programs in these marginalized populations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了泰国北部边缘化山区部落和无国籍儿童因乙型肝炎 疫苗 引起的免疫力欠佳的公共卫生问题,疫苗接种 项目于 1992 年开始在泰国北部开展。该研究旨在量化完全和部分接种疫苗的儿童之间的血清保护差异,并确定与缺乏抗 HBs 抗体相关的因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在清莱府 Mae Fah Luang 区的村庄进行了一项病例对照研究,招募了山地部落和五岁的无国籍儿童。病例是既往未接种、延迟接种或不完全接种乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的儿童,而对照是完全接种疫苗的儿童。
elements_zh.methods: 进行问卷调查并采集 3 mL 血样用于乙型肝炎生物标志物的定性和定量检测。使用逻辑回归来检测与抗-HBs 缺失相关的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 总体抗-HBs 患病率 为59.3%,在完全接种和不完全接种的儿童中检出率为55.3%(完全接种的儿童中有2 名抗-HBc 阳性)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将低血清保护率解释为不良现象,并强调孕妇的瑶族血统和低出生体重是抗 HBs 缺失的有力预测因素。他们的结论是,需要一个有效的评估计划来监测 疫苗 在这些人群中诱导的免疫力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,有必要对泰国北部的山区部落和无国籍儿童进行有针对性的 疫苗接种 计划和 疫苗接种 后血清监测,以提高乙型肝炎免疫力并降低 传播 风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的横断面设计和对自我报告的 疫苗接种 状态的依赖限制了因果推断,并可能低估了真正的血清保护差距。由于潜在的选择偏差和未测量的混杂因素,证据是中等的。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了泰国北部边缘化山区部落和无国籍儿童因乙型肝炎 疫苗 引起的免疫力欠佳的公共卫生问题,疫苗接种 项目于 1992 年开始在泰国北部开展。该研究旨在量化完全和部分接种疫苗的儿童之间的血清保护差异,并确定与缺乏抗 HBs 抗体相关的因素。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 在清莱府 Mae Fah Luang 区的村庄进行了一项病例对照研究,招募了山地部落和五岁的无国籍儿童。病例是既往未接种、延迟接种或不完全接种乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 的儿童,而对照是完全接种疫苗的儿童。
analysis_zh.methods: 进行问卷调查并采集 3 mL 血样用于乙型肝炎生物标志物的定性和定量检测。使用逻辑回归来检测与抗-HBs 缺失相关的因素。
analysis_zh.main_results: 总体抗-HBs 患病率 为59.3%,在完全接种和不完全接种的儿童中检出率为55.3%(完全接种的儿童中有2 名抗-HBc 阳性)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将低血清保护率解释为不良现象,并强调孕妇的瑶族血统和低出生体重是抗 HBs 缺失的有力预测因素。他们的结论是,需要一个有效的评估计划来监测 疫苗 在这些人群中诱导的免疫力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,有必要对泰国北部的山区部落和无国籍儿童进行有针对性的 疫苗接种 计划和 疫苗接种 后血清监测,以提高乙型肝炎免疫力并降低 传播 风险。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的横断面设计和对自我报告的 疫苗接种 状态的依赖限制了因果推断,并可能低估了真正的血清保护差距。由于潜在的选择偏差和未测量的混杂因素,证据是中等的。

papers.title: Spatial and Temporal Disparities in Timely Hepatitis B Birth-Dose Vaccination in Chongqing, China, 2016–2025
papers.abstract: Background: Timely hepatitis B vaccine birth-dose (HepBV-BD) vaccination is a cornerstone strategy for preventing mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus (HBV). Although hepatitis B vaccination coverage in China has improved substantially, evidence regarding long-term district-level spatiotemporal inequalities in timely birth-dose vaccination remains limited, particularly in western China. This study assessed spatiotemporal disparities in hepatitis B vaccination coverage across Chongqing, China, from 2016 to 2025. Methods: This ecological descriptive study used district- and county-level vaccination surveillance data from the Chongqing Immunization Information Management System. Temporal trends in HepBV-BD, timely birth-dose (TBD), HepBV2, and HepBV3 coverage were analyzed. Regional disparities, interregional inequalities, and spatial clustering were assessed using Global Moran’s I and Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA). Results: All vaccination indicators improved substantially during the study period. TBD coverage increased from 81.9% to 95.4%, whereas HepBV3 coverage increased from 83.7% to 98.7%. TBD coverage was strongly positively associated with HepBV3 coverage(r = 0.95, p < 0.001). Mountainous ethnic minority regions consistently exhibited the lowest TBD coverage despite marked improvement over time. Absolute interregional inequality decreased from 30.8 to 8.4 percentage points. Although Global Moran’s I was not statistically significant, LISA analysis identified persistent localized low-coverage clusters in southeastern mountainous regions and emerging high–high clusters in northern Chongqing. Conclusions: Hepatitis B vaccination coverage in Chongqing improved markedly between 2016 and 2025, accompanied by declining geographic inequality. Nevertheless, persistent spatial inequities in timely birth-dose vaccination remained in mountainous ethnic minority areas. Continued monitoring of spatial inequalities, together with strengthened primary healthcare capacity, culturally tailored health education, and equitable resource allocation, may help support geographically targeted immunization strategies and accelerate progress toward the WHO goal of eliminating viral hepatitis as a public health threat by 2030.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Timely hepatitis B vaccine birth-dose (HepBV-BD) vaccination is critical for preventing mother-to-child transmission of HBV, yet long-term district-level spatiotemporal inequalities in timely birth-dose vaccination remain insufficiently characterized, particularly in western China.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This ecological descriptive study analyzed district- and county-level vaccination surveillance data from the Chongqing Immunization Information Management System covering the period 2016 to 2025.
analysis.methods: Temporal trends in HepBV-BD, timely birth-dose (TBD), HepBV2, and HepBV3 coverage were assessed, and regional disparities, interregional inequalities, and spatial clustering were evaluated using Global Moran’s I and Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA).
analysis.main_results: All vaccination indicators improved substantially during the study period, with TBD coverage increasing from 81.9% to 95.4% and HepBV3 coverage rising from 83.7% to 98.7%. TBD coverage was strongly positively associated with HepBV3 coverage (r = 0.95, p < 0.001).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found marked overall improvement in hepatitis B vaccination coverage in Chongqing alongside declining geographic inequality, but persistent spatial inequities remained in mountainous ethnic minority areas, highlighting the need for geographically targeted immunization strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support continued monitoring of spatial inequalities and targeted interventions such as strengthening primary healthcare capacity, culturally tailored health education, and equitable resource allocation to accelerate progress toward WHO’s goal of eliminating viral hepatitis as a public health threat by 2030.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The ecological design and reliance on surveillance data limit causal inference and may obscure individual-level determinants, while the absence of statistically significant Global Moran’s I suggests weak global spatial autocorrelation despite identified localized clusters.

analysis.summary_en: This ecological study assessed spatiotemporal disparities in hepatitis B vaccination coverage across Chongqing, China, from 2016 to 2025 using district-level surveillance data. All vaccination indicators improved substantially, with timely birth-dose (TBD) coverage rising from 81.9% to 95.4% and HepBV3 coverage from 83.7% to 98.7%. TBD coverage was strongly correlated with HepBV3 coverage (r = 0.95, p < 0.001). Despite overall progress, mountainous ethnic minority regions consistently showed the lowest TBD coverage, and localized low-coverage clusters persisted in southeastern areas. Absolute interregional inequality decreased from 30.8 to 8.4 percentage points, though Global Moran’s I was not statistically significant. The authors conclude that while geographic inequality declined, targeted interventions are needed to address persistent inequities and support progress toward WHO’s 2030 hepatitis elimination goals.

papers.title_zh: 2016-2025 年中国重庆及时乙型肝炎出生剂量 疫苗接种 的空间和时间差异
papers.source_body_en: Background: Timely hepatitis B vaccine birth-dose (HepBV-BD) vaccination is a cornerstone strategy for preventing mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus (HBV). Although hepatitis B vaccination coverage in China has improved substantially, evidence regarding long-term district-level spatiotemporal inequalities in timely birth-dose vaccination remains limited, particularly in western China. This study assessed spatiotemporal disparities in hepatitis B vaccination coverage across Chongqing, China, from 2016 to 2025. Methods: This ecological descriptive study used district- and county-level vaccination surveillance data from the Chongqing Immunization Information Management System. Temporal trends in HepBV-BD, timely birth-dose (TBD), HepBV2, and HepBV3 coverage were analyzed. Regional disparities, interregional inequalities, and spatial clustering were assessed using Global Moran’s I and Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA). Results: All vaccination indicators improved substantially during the study period. TBD coverage increased from 81.9% to 95.4%, whereas HepBV3 coverage increased from 83.7% to 98.7%. TBD coverage was strongly positively associated with HepBV3 coverage(r = 0.95, p < 0.001). Mountainous ethnic minority regions consistently exhibited the lowest TBD coverage despite marked improvement over time. Absolute interregional inequality decreased from 30.8 to 8.4 percentage points. Although Global Moran’s I was not statistically significant, LISA analysis identified persistent localized low-coverage clusters in southeastern mountainous regions and emerging high–high clusters in northern Chongqing. Conclusions: Hepatitis B vaccination coverage in Chongqing improved markedly between 2016 and 2025, accompanied by declining geographic inequality. Nevertheless, persistent spatial inequities in timely birth-dose vaccination remained in mountainous ethnic minority areas. Continued monitoring of spatial inequalities, together with strengthened primary healthcare capacity, culturally tailored health education, and equitable resource allocation, may help support geographically targeted immunization strategies and accelerate progress toward the WHO goal of eliminating viral hepatitis as a public health threat by 2030.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:及时乙型肝炎 疫苗 出生剂量 (HepBV-BD) 疫苗接种 是预防 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 母婴 传播 的基石策略。尽管中国的乙型肝炎覆盖率已大幅提高,但关于及时出生剂量 疫苗接种 的长期地区级时空不平等的证据仍然有限,特别是在中国西部。本研究评估了 2016 年至 2025 年中国重庆市乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 覆盖率的时空差异。方法:这项生态描述性研究使用了重庆市免疫信息管理系统的区县级 疫苗接种 监测 数据。分析了 HepBV-BD、及时出生剂量 (TBD)、HepBV2 和 HepBV3 覆盖率的时间趋势。使用全球 Moran’s I 和地方空间关联指标 (LISA) 评估区域差异、区域间不平等和空间聚集。结果:研究期间所有疫苗接种指标均大幅改善。TBD覆盖率从81.9%增加到95.4%,而HepBV3覆盖率从83.7%增加到98.7%。TBD 覆盖率与 HepBV3 覆盖率呈强正相关(r = 0.95,p < 0.001)。尽管随着时间的推移取得了显着改善,但山区少数民族地区的 TBD 覆盖率始终最低。区域间绝对不平等从 30.8 个百分点下降到 8.4 个百分点。尽管 Global Moran's I 没有统计显着性,但 LISA 分析发现东南山区持续存在局部低覆盖度集群,而重庆北部则出现了新兴的高-高集群。结论:2016 年至 2025 年间,重庆市乙型肝炎 疫苗接种 覆盖率显着提高,同时地理不平等现象也有所下降。然而,在山区少数民族地区,及时出生剂量疫苗接种仍然存在持续的空间不平等。持续监测空间不平等,加上加强初级卫生保健能力、针对文化的健康教育和公平的资源分配,可能有助于支持有针对性的地理免疫战略,并加快实现世卫组织到 2030 年消除病毒性肝炎这一公共卫生威胁的目标。

papers.title: Living-donor liver transplantation at 17 weeks gestation for hepatitis B virus-related acute liver failure with hepatic encephalopathy with emergency cesarean delivery at 34 weeks: a case report
papers.abstract: Liver transplantation during pregnancy is rare but may be lifesaving in cases of acute liver failure occurring before fetal viability. A primigravida with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection developed HBV-related acute liver failure with grade III hepatic encephalopathy at 17 weeks gestation. Because delivery could not improve fetal survival, the multidisciplinary team prioritized transplantation while pregnancy continued. Laboratory investigations demonstrated severe thrombocytopenia and hypofibrinogenemia. Anesthetic management was guided by predefined maternal physiologic and hematologic targets to support uteroplacental perfusion and included temporary portosystemic shunting. Staged fetal ultrasonography confirmed viability. Surgery lasted 10 h 55 min, with 2,410 mL blood loss. The mother recovered. Following preterm premature rupture of membranes, breech presentation prompted an emergency cesarean delivery at 34 weeks with spinal anesthesia, followed by neonatal intensive care. This case shows that when delivery cannot offer fetal rescue, urgent transplantation and continued pregnancy can be integrated through multidisciplinary decision-making and specialized perioperative management.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the clinical challenge of managing acute liver failure due to chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection during pregnancy, where fetal viability precludes delivery as a rescue strategy. It explores whether living-donor liver transplantation can be performed while maintaining pregnancy to optimize maternal and fetal outcomes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This is a single-case report of a primigravida with chronic HBV infection who developed HBV-related acute liver failure with hepatic encephalopathy at 17 weeks gestation. The case required multidisciplinary management including living-donor liver transplantation while pregnancy continued, followed by emergency cesarean delivery at 34 weeks.
analysis.methods: The anesthetic and surgical management involved predefined maternal physiologic and hematologic targets to support uteroplacental perfusion, including temporary portosystemic shunting. Maternal viability was prioritized through transplantation, with staged fetal ultrasonography confirming viability throughout the perioperative period.
analysis.main_results: Laboratory investigations revealed severe thrombocytopenia and hypofibrinogenemia. The surgical procedure lasted 10 hours 55 minutes with an estimated blood loss of 2,410 mL. The mother recovered fully, and the neonate required neonatal intensive care following emergency cesarean delivery at 34 weeks due to preterm premature rupture of membranes and breech presentation.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the case as demonstrating that when delivery cannot rescue the fetus, urgent liver transplantation combined with continued pregnancy is feasible through specialized multidisciplinary and perioperative management. The novelty lies in the integrated approach of performing transplantation during pregnancy to stabilize maternal HBV-related acute liver failure while preserving fetal viability.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This case highlights the potential for liver transplantation during pregnancy in HBV-related acute liver failure to improve maternal survival without compromising fetal outcomes when delivery is not a viable option. It underscores the need for specialized centers and protocols to manage such high-risk pregnancies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to a single case report, which restricts generalizability and precludes causal inference. The absence of a control group and reliance on a single-center experience reduce the strength of evidence to low, despite the detailed perioperative management described.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a primigravida with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection who developed HBV-related acute liver failure with hepatic encephalopathy at 17 weeks gestation. Because fetal viability precluded delivery as a rescue strategy, a multidisciplinary team performed living-donor liver transplantation while maintaining the pregnancy. Maternal laboratory abnormalities included severe thrombocytopenia and hypofibrinogenemia. The 10-hour 55-minute surgery resulted in 2,410 mL blood loss, but the mother recovered fully. Staged fetal ultrasonography confirmed viability throughout. Following preterm premature rupture of membranes and breech presentation, an emergency cesarean delivery was performed at 34 weeks, with the neonate requiring neonatal intensive care. The authors conclude that when delivery cannot improve fetal survival, urgent transplantation with continued pregnancy can be integrated through specialized perioperative management. However, the evidence is limited to a single case, restricting generalizability and the strength of conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了妊娠期间因 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染而导致的急性肝功能衰竭的临床挑战,其中胎儿存活率妨碍分娩作为一种救援策略。它探讨了是否可以在维持妊娠的同时进行活体肝移植,以优化母体和胎儿的结局。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一位患有慢性 HBV 感染的初产妇的单 病例报告,她在妊娠 17 周时出现了 HBV 相关的急性肝功能衰竭并伴有肝性脑病。该病例需要多学科治疗,包括在继续妊娠期间进行活体肝移植,然后在 34 周时进行紧急剖腹产。
elements_zh.methods: 麻醉和手术管理涉及预先确定的母体生理和血液学目标,以支持子宫胎盘灌注,包括临时门体分流。通过移植优先考虑母体的生存能力,并在整个围手术期通过分阶段的胎儿超声检查来确认母体的生存能力。
elements_zh.main_results: 实验室检查显示严重的血小板减少症和低纤维蛋白原血症。手术持续了 10 小时 55 分钟,预计失血量为 2,410 毫升。母亲已完全康复,34周时紧急剖腹产后,由于胎膜早破和臀位,新生儿需要新生儿重症监护。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此案例解读为,当分娩无法挽救胎儿时,通过专门的多学科和围手术期管理,紧急肝移植联合继续妊娠是可行的。新颖之处在于在怀孕期间进行移植的综合方法,以稳定母体与乙型肝炎相关的急性肝衰竭,同时保留胎儿的活力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该病例凸显了妊娠期肝移植治疗乙型肝炎相关急性肝功能衰竭的潜力,可以在分娩不可行的情况下提高孕产妇生存率,同时又不影响胎儿结局。它强调需要专门的中心和方案来管理此类高风险妊娠。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于单个 病例报告,这限制了普遍性并排除了因果推理。尽管描述了详细的围手术期管理,但缺乏对照组和对单中心经验的依赖将证据强度降低至低水平。

analysis_en.methods: The anesthetic and surgical management involved predefined maternal physiologic and hematologic targets to support uteroplacental perfusion, including temporary portosystemic shunting. Maternal viability was prioritized through transplantation, with staged fetal ultrasonography confirming viability throughout the perioperative period.
analysis_en.main_results: Laboratory investigations revealed severe thrombocytopenia and hypofibrinogenemia. The surgical procedure lasted 10 hours 55 minutes with an estimated blood loss of 2,410 mL. The mother recovered fully, and the neonate required neonatal intensive care following emergency cesarean delivery at 34 weeks due to preterm premature rupture of membranes and breech presentation.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the case as demonstrating that when delivery cannot rescue the fetus, urgent liver transplantation combined with continued pregnancy is feasible through specialized multidisciplinary and perioperative management. The novelty lies in the integrated approach of performing transplantation during pregnancy to stabilize maternal HBV-related acute liver failure while preserving fetal viability.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This case highlights the potential for liver transplantation during pregnancy in HBV-related acute liver failure to improve maternal survival without compromising fetal outcomes when delivery is not a viable option. It underscores the need for specialized centers and protocols to manage such high-risk pregnancies.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to a single case report, which restricts generalizability and precludes causal inference. The absence of a control group and reliance on a single-center experience reduce the strength of evidence to low, despite the detailed perioperative management described.

papers.title_zh: 妊娠 17 周时的活体肝移植治疗 乙型肝炎病毒 相关的急性肝衰竭伴肝性脑病,并在 34 周时紧急剖宫产:病例报告
papers.source_body_en: Liver transplantation during pregnancy is rare but may be lifesaving in cases of acute liver failure occurring before fetal viability. A primigravida with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection developed HBV-related acute liver failure with grade III hepatic encephalopathy at 17 weeks gestation. Because delivery could not improve fetal survival, the multidisciplinary team prioritized transplantation while pregnancy continued. Laboratory investigations demonstrated severe thrombocytopenia and hypofibrinogenemia. Anesthetic management was guided by predefined maternal physiologic and hematologic targets to support uteroplacental perfusion and included temporary portosystemic shunting. Staged fetal ultrasonography confirmed viability. Surgery lasted 10 h 55 min, with 2,410 mL blood loss. The mother recovered. Following preterm premature rupture of membranes, breech presentation prompted an emergency cesarean delivery at 34 weeks with spinal anesthesia, followed by neonatal intensive care. This case shows that when delivery cannot offer fetal rescue, urgent transplantation and continued pregnancy can be integrated through multidisciplinary decision-making and specialized perioperative management.
papers.abstract_zh: 怀孕期间的肝移植很少见,但在胎儿存活之前发生急性肝衰竭的情况下可能可以挽救生命。一名感染 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 的初产妇在妊娠 17 周时出现 HBV 相关急性肝功能衰竭并伴有 III 级肝性脑病。由于分娩无法提高胎儿存活率,多学科团队在妊娠继续期间优先考虑移植。实验室检查显示严重的血小板减少症和低纤维蛋白原血症。麻醉管理以预先确定的母体生理和血液学目标为指导,以支持子宫胎盘灌注,包括临时门体分流。分期胎儿超声检查证实了其生存能力。手术持续10小时55分钟,失血2,410毫升。母亲康复了。早产胎膜早破、臀位促使我们在 34 周时进行紧急剖腹产,并使用脊髓麻醉,随后接受新生儿重症监护。该病例表明,当分娩无法挽救胎儿时,可以通过多学科决策和专业化围手术期管理,将紧急移植和继续妊娠结合起来。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了妊娠期间因 慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染而导致的急性肝功能衰竭的临床挑战,其中胎儿存活率妨碍分娩作为一种救援策略。它探讨了是否可以在维持妊娠的同时进行活体肝移植,以优化母体和胎儿的结局。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一位患有慢性 HBV 感染的初产妇的单 病例报告,她在妊娠 17 周时出现了 HBV 相关的急性肝功能衰竭并伴有肝性脑病。该病例需要多学科治疗,包括在继续妊娠期间进行活体肝移植,然后在 34 周时进行紧急剖腹产。
analysis_zh.methods: 麻醉和手术管理涉及预先确定的母体生理和血液学目标,以支持子宫胎盘灌注,包括临时门体分流。通过移植优先考虑母体的生存能力,并在整个围手术期通过分阶段的胎儿超声检查来确认母体的生存能力。
analysis_zh.main_results: 实验室检查显示严重的血小板减少症和低纤维蛋白原血症。手术持续了 10 小时 55 分钟,预计失血量为 2,410 毫升。母亲已完全康复,34周时紧急剖腹产后,由于胎膜早破和臀位,新生儿需要新生儿重症监护。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此案例解读为,当分娩无法挽救胎儿时,通过专门的多学科和围手术期管理,紧急肝移植联合继续妊娠是可行的。新颖之处在于在怀孕期间进行移植的综合方法,以稳定母体与乙型肝炎相关的急性肝衰竭,同时保留胎儿的活力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该病例凸显了妊娠期肝移植治疗乙型肝炎相关急性肝功能衰竭的潜力,可以在分娩不可行的情况下提高孕产妇生存率,同时又不影响胎儿结局。它强调需要专门的中心和方案来管理此类高风险妊娠。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于单个 病例报告,这限制了普遍性并排除了因果推理。尽管描述了详细的围手术期管理,但缺乏对照组和对单中心经验的依赖将证据强度降低至低水平。

papers.title: [Analysis of influencing factors associated with cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase chronic hepatitis B].
papers.abstract: Objective: To analyze the influencing factors associated with cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase chronic hepatitis B (CHB). Methods: CHB patients in the indeterminate phase who did not receive antiviral treatment at the Senior Department of Hepatology, the Fifth Medical Center of Chinese PLA General Hospital between January 2020 and June 2025 were retrospectively included. According to whether cirrhosis had occurred, the patients were divided into the cirrhosis group (patients diagnosed with cirrhosis) and the non-cirrhosis group (patients not diagnosed with cirrhosis). Differences in demographic characteristics, virological indicators, routine blood parameters, and liver function-related clinical indicators were compared between the two groups. Restricted cubic spline analysis was used to determine the threshold values of platelet and age in relation to cirrhosis risk. A multivariate logistic regression model was used to analyze factors associated with cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB. Results: A total of 422 patients was included. There were 182 patients in the cirrhosis group with 128 males and 54 females, aged (47±9) years; and 240 patients in the non-cirrhosis group with 146 males and 94 females, aged (43±11) years. Patients in the cirrhosis group were older than those in the non-cirrhosis group (P<0.001). The distribution of HBV DNA differed statistically between the two groups (P=0.002). Compared with the non-cirrhosis group, the cirrhosis group had a lower proportion of low HBV DNA load (<2×103 U/ml) [14.8% (27/182) vs 29.6% (71/240), P<0.001] and a higher proportion of intermediate HBV DNA load (2×103-<2×107 U/ml) [67.6% (123/182) vs 57.5% (138/240), P=0.032], whereas the proportion of high HBV DNA load (≥2×107 U/ml) did not differ significantly [17.6% (32/182) vs 12.9% (31/240), P=0.160]. Platelet count [M (Q1, Q3), 158 (94, 199)×109/L vs 205 (171, 244)×109/L] and HBsAg levels (log HBsAg) [2.9 (2.5, 3.2) vs 3.1 (2.7, 3.6) U/ml] were lower in the cirrhosis group than those in the non-cirrhosis group (both P<0.001). Restricted cubic spline analysis showed non-linear associations of platelet count and age with cirrhosis risk in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB (P<0.05). The corresponding threshold values were 45 years and 180×109/L of age and platelet count, respectively. Multivariate logistic regression analysis showed that decreased HBsAg levels (log HbsAg) (OR=1.99, 95%CI: 1.35-2.93), HBV DNA between 2×103 and<2×107 U/ml (OR=2.12, 95%CI: 1.18-3.81), HBV DNA≥2×107 U/ml (OR=4.02, 95%CI: 1.80-9.00), age≥45 years (OR=2.06, 95%CI: 1.32-3.24), and platelet count<180×109/L (OR=3.99, 95%CI: 2.55-6.23) were associated with cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB. Conclusion: Age≥45 years, platelet count<180×109/L, HBV DNA≥2×103 U/ml and decreased HBsAg are influencing factors for the progression to cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB who did not receive antiviral treatment.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in the indeterminate phase poses a risk of progression to cirrhosis, yet factors influencing this transition remain insufficiently characterized. The study aimed to identify demographic, virological, and clinical indicators associated with cirrhosis in untreated patients with indeterminate-phase CHB.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This retrospective study enrolled 422 patients with indeterminate-phase CHB who had not received antiviral treatment at a single tertiary center in China between January 2020 and June 2025. Patients were stratified into a cirrhosis group (n=182) and a non-cirrhosis group (n=240) based on cirrhosis diagnosis.
analysis.methods: Differences in demographic characteristics, virological indicators (including HBV DNA and HBsAg levels), routine blood parameters, and liver function-related clinical indicators were compared between groups. Restricted cubic spline analysis was used to assess non-linear associations of platelet count and age with cirrhosis risk, and multivariate logistic regression identified factors independently associated with cirrhosis.
analysis.main_results: The cirrhosis group was older (47±9 vs 43±11 years, P<0.001) and had lower platelet counts [158 (94, 199) vs 205 (171, 244)×10^9/L, P<0.001] and HBsAg levels [2.9 (2.5, 3.2) vs 3.1 (2.7, 3.6) log U/ml, P<0.001]. HBV DNA distribution differed significantly (P=0.002), with higher proportions of intermediate HBV DNA load in the cirrhosis group. Age ≥45 years (OR=2.06, 95%CI: 1.32–3.24), platelet count <180×10^9/L (OR=3.99, 95%CI: 2.55–6.23), HBV DNA ≥2×10^3 U/ml (OR=2.12–4.02), and decreased HBsAg (OR=1.99, 95%CI: 1.35–2.93) were independently associated with cirrhosis.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study identifies age, platelet count, HBV DNA load, and HBsAg levels as key factors associated with cirrhosis progression in untreated indeterminate-phase CHB, highlighting non-linear risk thresholds for age and platelet count. These findings refine risk stratification in a population where antiviral therapy was not administered.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that routine monitoring of age, platelet count, HBV DNA, and HBsAg levels could improve early identification of CHB patients at risk of cirrhosis, particularly in settings where antiviral therapy is deferred. This may inform surveillance strategies and patient counseling in resource-limited environments.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The retrospective single-center design and lack of antiviral treatment data limit causal inference and generalizability. The evidence strength is moderate due to potential unmeasured confounding and the absence of longitudinal follow-up to confirm progression.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 422 patients with indeterminate-phase chronic hepatitis B (CHB) who had not received antiviral treatment, comparing those with and without cirrhosis. Older age, lower platelet counts, and specific HBV DNA and HBsAg levels were independently associated with cirrhosis. Non-linear risk thresholds were identified for age (≥45 years) and platelet count (<180×10^9/L). The findings suggest that demographic and virological indicators could aid risk stratification for cirrhosis in untreated CHB patients, though the single-center design and lack of treatment data constrain generalizability.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Chronic hepatitis B (CHB) in the indeterminate phase poses a risk of progression to cirrhosis, yet factors influencing this transition remain insufficiently characterized. The study aimed to identify demographic, virological, and clinical indicators associated with cirrhosis in untreated patients with indeterminate-phase CHB.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This retrospective study enrolled 422 patients with indeterminate-phase CHB who had not received antiviral treatment at a single tertiary center in China between January 2020 and June 2025. Patients were stratified into a cirrhosis group (n=182) and a non-cirrhosis group (n=240) based on cirrhosis diagnosis.
analysis_en.methods: Differences in demographic characteristics, virological indicators (including HBV DNA and HBsAg levels), routine blood parameters, and liver function-related clinical indicators were compared between groups. Restricted cubic spline analysis was used to assess non-linear associations of platelet count and age with cirrhosis risk, and multivariate logistic regression identified factors independently associated with cirrhosis.
analysis_en.main_results: The cirrhosis group was older (47±9 vs 43±11 years, P<0.001) and had lower platelet counts [158 (94, 199) vs 205 (171, 244)×10^9/L, P<0.001] and HBsAg levels [2.9 (2.5, 3.2) vs 3.1 (2.7, 3.6) log U/ml, P<0.001]. HBV DNA distribution differed significantly (P=0.002), with higher proportions of intermediate HBV DNA load in the cirrhosis group. Age ≥45 years (OR=2.06, 95%CI: 1.32–3.24), platelet count <180×10^9/L (OR=3.99, 95%CI: 2.55–6.23), HBV DNA ≥2×10^3 U/ml (OR=2.12–4.02), and decreased HBsAg (OR=1.99, 95%CI: 1.35–2.93) were independently associated with cirrhosis.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study identifies age, platelet count, HBV DNA load, and HBsAg levels as key factors associated with cirrhosis progression in untreated indeterminate-phase CHB, highlighting non-linear risk thresholds for age and platelet count. These findings refine risk stratification in a population where antiviral therapy was not administered.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that routine monitoring of age, platelet count, HBV DNA, and HBsAg levels could improve early identification of CHB patients at risk of cirrhosis, particularly in settings where antiviral therapy is deferred. This may inform surveillance strategies and patient counseling in resource-limited environments.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The retrospective single-center design and lack of antiviral treatment data limit causal inference and generalizability. The evidence strength is moderate due to potential unmeasured confounding and the absence of longitudinal follow-up to confirm progression.

papers.title_zh: 不确定期慢性乙型肝炎患者肝硬化影响因素分析
papers.source_body_en: Objective: To analyze the influencing factors associated with cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase chronic hepatitis B (CHB). Methods: CHB patients in the indeterminate phase who did not receive antiviral treatment at the Senior Department of Hepatology, the Fifth Medical Center of Chinese PLA General Hospital between January 2020 and June 2025 were retrospectively included. According to whether cirrhosis had occurred, the patients were divided into the cirrhosis group (patients diagnosed with cirrhosis) and the non-cirrhosis group (patients not diagnosed with cirrhosis). Differences in demographic characteristics, virological indicators, routine blood parameters, and liver function-related clinical indicators were compared between the two groups. Restricted cubic spline analysis was used to determine the threshold values of platelet and age in relation to cirrhosis risk. A multivariate logistic regression model was used to analyze factors associated with cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB. Results: A total of 422 patients was included. There were 182 patients in the cirrhosis group with 128 males and 54 females, aged (47±9) years; and 240 patients in the non-cirrhosis group with 146 males and 94 females, aged (43±11) years. Patients in the cirrhosis group were older than those in the non-cirrhosis group (P<0.001). The distribution of HBV DNA differed statistically between the two groups (P=0.002). Compared with the non-cirrhosis group, the cirrhosis group had a lower proportion of low HBV DNA load (<2×103 U/ml) [14.8% (27/182) vs 29.6% (71/240), P<0.001] and a higher proportion of intermediate HBV DNA load (2×103-<2×107 U/ml) [67.6% (123/182) vs 57.5% (138/240), P=0.032], whereas the proportion of high HBV DNA load (≥2×107 U/ml) did not differ significantly [17.6% (32/182) vs 12.9% (31/240), P=0.160]. Platelet count [M (Q1, Q3), 158 (94, 199)×109/L vs 205 (171, 244)×109/L] and HBsAg levels (log HBsAg) [2.9 (2.5, 3.2) vs 3.1 (2.7, 3.6) U/ml] were lower in the cirrhosis group than those in the non-cirrhosis group (both P<0.001). Restricted cubic spline analysis showed non-linear associations of platelet count and age with cirrhosis risk in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB (P<0.05). The corresponding threshold values were 45 years and 180×109/L of age and platelet count, respectively. Multivariate logistic regression analysis showed that decreased HBsAg levels (log HbsAg) (OR=1.99, 95%CI: 1.35-2.93), HBV DNA between 2×103 and<2×107 U/ml (OR=2.12, 95%CI: 1.18-3.81), HBV DNA≥2×107 U/ml (OR=4.02, 95%CI: 1.80-9.00), age≥45 years (OR=2.06, 95%CI: 1.32-3.24), and platelet count<180×109/L (OR=3.99, 95%CI: 2.55-6.23) were associated with cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB. Conclusion: Age≥45 years, platelet count<180×109/L, HBV DNA≥2×103 U/ml and decreased HBsAg are influencing factors for the progression to cirrhosis in patients with indeterminate-phase CHB who did not receive antiviral treatment.

papers.title: The BTLA/HVEM axis as a key regulator for stratified functional cure in chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: Background Functional cure rates in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remain below 10% after long-term nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy, and PD-1/PD-L1 blockade achieves HBsAg clearance in approximately 30% of selected patients with low baseline HBsAg (≤100 IU/mL). This shortfall reflects an oversimplified view of T-cell exhaustion that neglects nonredundant checkpoints operating in parallel with PD-1. Main arguments We synthesize emerging evidence (2019–2025) to position the B and T lymphocyte attenuator (BTLA)/herpesvirus entry mediator (HVEM) axis as an emerging candidate hub for layered therapeutic strategies in HBV infection. BTLA preferentially recruits SHP-1 (versus PD-1-predominant SHP-2) and signals via PI3K–AKT to sustain terminal exhaustion independently of PD-1 status. BTLA preferentially recruits SHP-1 (Src homology region 2 domain-containing phosphatase-1) [versus PD-1-predominant SHP-2 (Src homology region 2 domain-containing phosphatase-2)] and signals via PI3K–AKT to constrain TPEX proliferation and effector differentiation independently of PD-1 status. In CHB, BTLA is upregulated on peripheral and intrahepatic CD4+ and CD8+ T cells, correlating with ALT/AST and histologic activity; however, this correlation should be interpreted cautiously, as elevated liver enzymes primarily reflect immune-mediated hepatocellular injury during active inflammation rather than purely antiviral immune dysfunction. In HBV-related acute-on-chronic liver failure (HBV-ACLF), CD4+ T-cell BTLA expression independently predicts 90-day mortality and secondary infections. Soluble BTLA has emerged as a candidate minimally invasive biomarker for risk stratification in resource-limited settings. Conclusion Under low antigen load following long-term NA suppression (HBsAg <100 IU/mL), biomarker-guided combination therapy targeting BTLA/HVEM alongside PD-1 may expand functional cure rates beyond the ceiling of single-checkpoint blockade. We outline an adaptive Phase I trial concept with predefined stratification thresholds to enable reproducible translation in HBV-endemic regions.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the low functional cure rates in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) after long-term nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy and the limited success of PD-1/PD-L1 blockade in achieving HBsAg clearance. The background highlights the need for a more nuanced understanding of T-cell exhaustion mechanisms beyond PD-1.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a synthesis of emerging evidence from 2019 to 2025, focusing on human hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, particularly chronic hepatitis B. It examines the role of the BTLA/HVEM axis in T-cell exhaustion and its potential as a therapeutic target.
analysis.methods: The methods involve analyzing existing literature and data on the BTLA/HVEM axis, its signaling pathways, and its expression in CD4+ and CD8+ T cells during HBV infection. The study also outlines an adaptive Phase I trial concept for future research.
analysis.main_results: The study reports that BTLA preferentially recruits SHP-1 over PD-1-predominant SHP-2 and signals via PI3K–AKT to sustain terminal exhaustion independently of PD-1 status. It also notes that BTLA expression correlates with ALT/AST and histologic activity in CHB, though this correlation should be interpreted cautiously.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret these findings as evidence that the BTLA/HVEM axis operates as a nonredundant checkpoint, offering a new therapeutic strategy for HBV infection. This positions the axis as an emerging candidate for layered therapeutic approaches.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that targeting the BTLA/HVEM axis in combination with PD-1 could improve functional cure rates in CHB, potentially leading to better treatment strategies in HBV-endemic regions.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a synthesis of existing literature and does not include original data. The correlation between BTLA expression and liver enzymes should be interpreted cautiously, as it may reflect immune-mediated injury rather than purely antiviral immune dysfunction.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the low functional cure rates in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) after long-term nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) therapy and the limited success of PD-1/PD-L1 blockade. It highlights the need for a more nuanced understanding of T-cell exhaustion mechanisms beyond PD-1. The research synthesizes evidence from 2019 to 2025 to position the BTLA/HVEM axis as an emerging therapeutic target. The study reports that BTLA preferentially recruits SHP-1 over SHP-2 and signals via PI3K–AKT to sustain terminal exhaustion independently of PD-1 status. It also notes that BTLA expression correlates with liver enzymes and histologic activity in CHB, though this correlation may reflect immune-mediated injury. The authors interpret these findings as evidence that the BTLA/HVEM axis operates as a nonredundant checkpoint, offering a new therapeutic strategy. The study suggests that targeting this axis in combination with PD-1 could improve functional cure rates, potentially leading to better treatment strategies in HBV-endemic regions. However, the study is based on a synthesis of existing literature and does not include original data, which limits the strength of the evidence.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决长期核苷(酸)类似物(NA)治疗后慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)中功能性治愈率低以及PD-1/PD-L1阻断在实现HBsAg清除方面取得的有限成功的问题。这一背景凸显了需要对 PD-1 之外的 T 细胞耗竭机制有更细致的了解。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究综合了 2019 年至 2025 年的新证据,重点关注人类 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染,特别是 慢性乙型肝炎。它检查了 BTLA/HVEM 轴在 T 细胞耗竭中的作用及其作为治疗靶点的潜力。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及分析有关 BTLA/HVEM 轴、其信号通路及其在 HBV 感染期间在 CD4+ 和 CD8+ T 细胞中表达的现有文献和数据。该研究还概述了未来研究的适应性第一阶段试验概念。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究报告称,BTLA 优先招募 SHP-1,而不是以 PD-1 为主的 SHP-2,并通过 PI3K-AKT 发出信号,以独立于 PD-1 状态维持终末衰竭。它还指出,BTLA 表达与 CHB 中的 ALT/AST 和组织学活性相关,但应谨慎解释这种相关性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为 BTLA/HVEM 轴作为非冗余检查点发挥作用的证据,为 HBV 感染提供了一种新的治疗策略。这使得该轴成为分层治疗方法的新兴候选者。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,针对 BTLA/HVEM 轴与 PD-1 相结合可以提高慢性乙型肝炎的 功能性治愈 率,从而可能在 HBV 流行地区产生更好的 治疗 策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于现有文献的综合,不包括原始数据。应谨慎解释 BTLA 表达与肝酶之间的相关性,因为它可能反映免疫介导的损伤,而不是纯粹的 抗病毒药物 免疫功能障碍。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 中的 功能性治愈 率在长期核苷(酸)类似物 (NA) 治疗后仍低于 10%,并且 PD-1/PD-L1 阻断在大约 30% 的低基线 HBsAg (≤100 IU/mL) 选定患者中实现 HBsAg 清除。这种不足反映了对 T 细胞耗竭的过于简单化的看法,忽略了与 PD-1 并行运行的非冗余检查点。主要论点 我们综合了新出现的证据(2019-2025),将 B 淋巴细胞和 T 淋巴细胞衰减因子 (BTLA)/疱疹病毒进入介导因子 (HVEM) 轴定位为 HBV 感染分层治疗策略的新兴候选中心。BTLA 优先招募 SHP-1(相对于以 PD-1 为主的 SHP-2)并通过 PI3K-AKT 发出信号,以独立于 PD-1 状态维持终末衰竭。BTLA 优先招募 SHP-1(包含 Src 同源区 2 结构域的磷酸酶-1)[相对于以 PD-1 为主的 SHP-2(包含 Src 同源区 2 结构域的磷酸酶-2)] 并通过 PI3K–AKT 发出信号,以独立于 PD-1 状态限制 TPEX 增殖和效应器分化。在 CHB 中,外周和肝内 CD4+ 和 CD8+ T 细胞的 BTLA 上调,与 ALT/AST 和组织学活性相关;然而,这种相关性应谨慎解释,因为肝酶升高主要反映了活动性炎症期间免疫介导的肝细胞损伤,而不是纯粹的 抗病毒药物 免疫功能障碍。在 HBV 相关慢性肝衰竭 (HBV-ACLF) 中,CD4+ T 细胞 BTLA 表达独立预测 90 天 死亡率 和继发感染。可溶性 BTLA 已成为资源有限环境中风险分层的候选微创生物标志物。结论 在长期 NA 抑制后的低抗原负荷(HBsAg <100 IU/mL)下,生物标志物引导下的 BTLA/HVEM 联合 PD-1 联合治疗可能会将 功能性治愈 率扩大到单检查点阻断的上限之外。我们概述了具有预定义分层阈值的适应性 I 期试验概念,以实现 HBV 流行地区的可重复翻译。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决长期核苷(酸)类似物(NA)治疗后慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)中功能性治愈率低以及PD-1/PD-L1阻断在实现HBsAg清除方面取得的有限成功的问题。这一背景凸显了需要对 PD-1 之外的 T 细胞耗竭机制有更细致的了解。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究综合了 2019 年至 2025 年的新证据,重点关注人类 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染,特别是 慢性乙型肝炎。它检查了 BTLA/HVEM 轴在 T 细胞耗竭中的作用及其作为治疗靶点的潜力。
analysis_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及分析有关 BTLA/HVEM 轴、其信号通路及其在 HBV 感染期间在 CD4+ 和 CD8+ T 细胞中表达的现有文献和数据。该研究还概述了未来研究的适应性第一阶段试验概念。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究报告称,BTLA 优先招募 SHP-1,而不是以 PD-1 为主的 SHP-2,并通过 PI3K-AKT 发出信号,以独立于 PD-1 状态维持终末衰竭。它还指出,BTLA 表达与 CHB 中的 ALT/AST 和组织学活性相关,但应谨慎解释这种相关性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为 BTLA/HVEM 轴作为非冗余检查点发挥作用的证据,为 HBV 感染提供了一种新的治疗策略。这使得该轴成为分层治疗方法的新兴候选者。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,针对 BTLA/HVEM 轴与 PD-1 相结合可以提高慢性乙型肝炎的 功能性治愈 率,从而可能在 HBV 流行地区产生更好的 治疗 策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于现有文献的综合,不包括原始数据。应谨慎解释 BTLA 表达与肝酶之间的相关性,因为它可能反映免疫介导的损伤,而不是纯粹的 抗病毒药物 免疫功能障碍。

papers.title: Burden of Hepatitis B virus infection among pregnant women attending antenatal care clinic at the University of Gondar Comprehensive Specialized Hospital, Northwest Ethiopia
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection poses a serious public health challenge globally. Despite HBV vaccination providing over 95% protection against chronic infection, mother-to-child transmission remains the leading cause of a higher prevalence of HBV infection. Thus, this study aimed to determine the magnitude of HBV infection among pregnant women visiting an antenatal care clinic in northwest Ethiopia. A facility-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 292 pregnant women from May to August 2023 at the University of Gondar Comprehensive Specialized Hospital antenatal care (ANC) clinic, Gondar, Northwest Ethiopia. A simple random sampling technique was employed to recruit pregnant women. Sociodemographic, clinical, and other factors were collected using a structured questionnaire. Five milliliters of venous blood were collected using a Vacutainer tube. Serum samples were isolated and tested for HBsAg using a one-step HBsAg test strip, with further confirmation through an Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA) test kit. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 26, and the association between HBV infection and predictor variables was computed using a logistic regression analysis. A p-value of ≤ 0.05 with a 95% confidence interval was considered statistically significant. The age range of pregnant women was from 18 to 44 years, with a mean (SD) age of 28.3 (5.5) years. The overall prevalence of HBV infection among pregnant women was 3.1% (95% CI: 1.4–5.8). An intermediate prevalence of HBV infection was found among pregnant women. To reduce the burden of HBV infection in these study groups, it is critical to enhance public awareness, expand HBV vaccination programs, increase HBV screening, and provide early treatment.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health problem globally, and mother-to-child transmission persists as a leading driver of chronic infection despite high vaccine efficacy. The study addressed the knowledge gap regarding the burden of HBV infection among pregnant women in a specific Ethiopian setting.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A facility-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 292 pregnant women attending the antenatal care clinic at the University of Gondar Comprehensive Specialized Hospital from May to August 2023 in Gondar, Northwest Ethiopia. Participants were recruited using a simple random sampling technique.
analysis.methods: Sociodemographic, clinical, and other factors were collected via a structured questionnaire. Five milliliters of venous blood were collected and serum samples were isolated and tested for HBsAg using a one-step HBsAg test strip, with confirmation by ELISA. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 26, and logistic regression was used to assess associations between HBV infection and predictor variables.
analysis.main_results: The overall prevalence of HBV infection among pregnant women was 3.1% (95% CI: 1.4–5.8), indicating an intermediate prevalence level.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the intermediate prevalence as evidence of ongoing HBV transmission risk in this population and highlighted the need for enhanced screening and vaccination strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support strengthening HBV screening programs, expanding vaccination coverage, and improving public awareness to reduce mother-to-child transmission in antenatal care settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The cross-sectional design and single-center sampling limit causal inference and generalizability, and reliance on HBsAg detection alone may underestimate occult HBV infection, warranting cautious interpretation of the evidence strength as moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed the burden of hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection among 292 pregnant women attending an antenatal care clinic in Gondar, Northwest Ethiopia, from May to August 2023. Using a cross-sectional design, the authors found an overall HBV prevalence of 3.1% (95% CI: 1.4–5.8), classifying it as intermediate. Data were collected via structured questionnaires and blood samples tested for HBsAg using rapid test strips and ELISA, with logistic regression used to analyze associations. The authors interpret the intermediate prevalence as indicative of ongoing transmission risk and emphasize the need for enhanced screening, vaccination, and public awareness to reduce mother-to-child transmission. However, the single-center, cross-sectional design and reliance on HBsAg detection alone limit causal inference and may underestimate occult infection, reducing confidence in the findings.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持加强 HBV 筛查计划、扩大 传播 覆盖范围并提高公众意识,以减少产前护理机构中的母婴 传播。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将他们的发现解释为表明大戟提取物对 乙型肝炎病毒 相关肝细胞癌的 治疗 具有潜在的治疗作用。然而,撤回意味着支持这种解释的证据不再被认为是可靠的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 如果该发现有效,可能会为未来针对 乙型肝炎病毒 相关肝细胞癌的 治疗 天然化合物的研究提供信息。然而,撤回限制了该研究的科学和公共卫生意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于原始研究的撤回,证据受到限制,这引发了人们对研究结果的可靠性和可重复性的担忧。因此,结果的可信度较低。

papers.title: Association between the IL-35 rs583911 polymorphism and hepatocellular carcinoma risk in patients infected with chronic hepatitis B virus
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The immunoregulatory cytokine interleukin (IL)-35 has been implicated in the pathogenesis of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Here, we explored the association between single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in the IL-35 gene and the occurrence of HCC in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV). Methods We selected 39 patients with chronic hepatitis B (HBV) and 52 patients with HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) as the case groups, along with 42 healthy individuals as the control group. We genotyped five IL-35-related single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) and analyzed their association with HCC risk. In addition, serum IL-35 levels, lymphocyte counts, and regulatory T cell (Treg) frequencies were measured in peripheral blood across all groups. Results The frequency of the rs583911 AA genotype tended to increase from healthy controls (4.8%) to patients with chronic HBV (10.3%) to patients with HCC (21.2%) (P for trend = 0.03). When patients with HCC were compared to non-HCC controls (healthy controls + chronic HBV carriers), the rs583911 AA genotype was associated with HCC risk (OR = 3.35; 95% CI: 1.17–9.61, P = 0.020). After adjusting for age, sex, cirrhosis status, and antiviral therapy, the association was no longer statistically significant (adjusted P = 0.085). Serum IL-35 levels were significantly elevated in both the HBV and the HCC groups compared with those in the control group ( P < 0.001), with no significant difference between the HBV and the HCC groups ( P = 0.434). Within the HCC subgroup, patients with the AA genotype tended to have higher IL-35 levels ( P = 0.047). Flow cytometry analysis of a subset of samples (6 controls, 6 patients with HBV, and 28 patients with HCC) revealed that the number of Treg cells was greater in patients with HCC than in those with HBV ( P = 0.038). Conclusion Our findings suggest a potential association between the rs583911 AA genotype and HBV-related HCC risk. However, these exploratory findings did not remain statistically significant after rigorous adjustment for multiple comparisons and potential confounders; therefore, validation in larger, independent cohorts is needed.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed whether polymorphisms in the immunoregulatory cytokine IL-35 gene are associated with increased risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) among patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, given prior evidence implicating IL-35 in HCC pathogenesis.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This case-control study enrolled 39 patients with chronic HBV, 52 patients with HBV-related HCC, and 42 healthy controls, all genotyped for five IL-35-related SNPs and assessed for serum IL-35 levels, lymphocyte counts, and regulatory T cell frequencies.
analysis.methods: Five IL-35-related SNPs were genotyped across groups, and serum IL-35 levels, lymphocyte counts, and regulatory T cell frequencies were measured in peripheral blood; flow cytometry was performed on a subset for Treg quantification.
analysis.main_results: The rs583911 AA genotype frequency increased from 4.8% in controls to 10.3% in chronic HBV and 21.2% in HCC (P for trend = 0.03), and was associated with HCC risk versus non-HCC controls (OR = 3.35; 95% CI: 1.17–9.61, P = 0.020), though significance was lost after adjustment (adjusted P = 0.085).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as suggesting a potential association between the rs583911 AA genotype and HBV-related HCC risk, noting elevated IL-35 levels in HBV and HCC groups and increased Tregs in HCC, though the association did not withstand rigorous adjustment.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: If validated, these findings could inform genetic risk stratification for HCC among chronic HBV patients and guide future studies on IL-35 pathways in HBV-related carcinogenesis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by small sample size, lack of multiple comparison adjustment, and potential confounding, yielding low confidence in the observed association; larger, independent cohorts are required for validation.

analysis.summary_en: This case-control study investigated whether IL-35 gene polymorphisms are associated with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk in chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) patients. Among 133 participants (39 chronic HBV, 52 HBV-related HCC, 42 healthy controls), the rs583911 AA genotype frequency increased from 4.8% in controls to 21.2% in HCC (P for trend = 0.03), and was associated with HCC risk versus non-HCC controls (OR = 3.35; 95% CI: 1.17–9.61, P = 0.020). However, significance was lost after adjusting for confounders (adjusted P = 0.085). Serum IL-35 levels were elevated in HBV and HCC groups compared to controls (P < 0.001), with no difference between HBV and HCC groups (P = 0.434). Within HCC, the AA genotype tended to associate with higher IL-35 levels (P = 0.047), and Treg counts were higher in HCC than HBV (P = 0.038). The authors conclude there may be a potential association between rs583911 and HBV-related HCC risk, but stress the need for validation in larger cohorts due to study limitations.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study addressed whether polymorphisms in the immunoregulatory cytokine IL-35 gene are associated with increased risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) among patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection, given prior evidence implicating IL-35 in HCC pathogenesis.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This case-control study enrolled 39 patients with chronic HBV, 52 patients with HBV-related HCC, and 42 healthy controls, all genotyped for five IL-35-related SNPs and assessed for serum IL-35 levels, lymphocyte counts, and regulatory T cell frequencies.
analysis_en.methods: Five IL-35-related SNPs were genotyped across groups, and serum IL-35 levels, lymphocyte counts, and regulatory T cell frequencies were measured in peripheral blood; flow cytometry was performed on a subset for Treg quantification.
analysis_en.main_results: The rs583911 AA genotype frequency increased from 4.8% in controls to 10.3% in chronic HBV and 21.2% in HCC (P for trend = 0.03), and was associated with HCC risk versus non-HCC controls (OR = 3.35; 95% CI: 1.17–9.61, P = 0.020), though significance was lost after adjustment (adjusted P = 0.085).

analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: If validated, these findings could inform genetic risk stratification for HCC among chronic HBV patients and guide future studies on IL-35 pathways in HBV-related carcinogenesis.
